+"""Build sgl-deep-gemm 0.2.3.post2 with the MegaMoE decode block_m heuristic.
+
+python/pyproject.toml pins sgl-deep-gemm 0.2.3.post2. MegaMoE wide-EP decode wants
+sgl-project/DeepGEMM#130 (block_m 64 for decode-sized loads), which is host-side heuristic code
+compiled into deep_gemm/_C.so, so the PyPI wheel cannot be patched in place. This builds the
+v0.2.3.post2 tag with that one change and replaces the installed wheel. It fails if another
+sgl-deep-gemm version is installed, so a pin bump cannot be silently rebuilt back to 0.2.3.post2.
+
+Idempotent: a marker next to the installed _C.so records this recipe's key and the module's
+sha256, so a rerun is a no-op unless the recipe changed or a reinstall replaced the wheel.
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import sysconfig
+import tempfile
+from importlib.metadata import version
+from pathlib import Path
+
+DEEPGEMM_REPO = "https://github.com/sgl-project/DeepGEMM"
+DEEPGEMM_VERSION = "0.2.3.post2"
+DEEPGEMM_COMMIT = "3bd6c364e49d5c34f2f0819b6f632bd6f7a3503a"  # tag v0.2.3.post2
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+PATCH = HERE / "deepgemm-mega-moe-decode-block-m.patch"
+# deep_jit includes elfutils/libdwfl.h, which the nightly image does not ship.
+APT_PACKAGES = ["libdw-dev"]
+
+SITE = Path(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"])
+MARKER = SITE / "deep_gemm/k31-deepgemm.json"
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def module() -> Path:
+    found = sorted((SITE / "deep_gemm").glob("_C*.so"))
+    if not found:
+        raise SystemExit("no deep_gemm/_C*.so is installed")
+    return found[0]
+
+
+def run(*cmd: str, cwd: Path) -> None:
+    print("+", " ".join(cmd), flush=True)
+    subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, check=True)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    installed = version("sgl-deep-gemm")
+    if installed != DEEPGEMM_VERSION:
+        raise SystemExit(
+            f"sgl-deep-gemm {installed} is installed; the MegaMoE decode patch is for "
+            f"{DEEPGEMM_VERSION}: update DEEPGEMM_VERSION, DEEPGEMM_COMMIT and the patch"
+        )
+    key = hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes() + PATCH.read_bytes()).hexdigest()[
+        :16
+    ]
+    if MARKER.exists():
+        marker = json.loads(MARKER.read_text())
+        if marker.get("key") == key and marker.get("module_sha256") == sha256(module()):
+            print(
+                f"sgl-deep-gemm already built with the MegaMoE decode patch (key {key})"
+            )
+            return
+
+    run("apt-get", "update", "-qq", cwd=Path("/"))
+    run(
+        "apt-get",
+        "install",
+        "-y",
+        "-qq",
+        "--no-install-recommends",
+        *APT_PACKAGES,
+        cwd=Path("/"),
+    )
+    run("bash", "-c", "rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*", cwd=Path("/"))
+
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        src = Path(tmp) / "DeepGEMM"
+        run("git", "clone", "--quiet", DEEPGEMM_REPO, str(src), cwd=Path(tmp))
+        run("git", "checkout", "--quiet", DEEPGEMM_COMMIT, cwd=src)
+        run("git", "submodule", "update", "--init", "--recursive", "--quiet", cwd=src)
+        run("git", "apply", str(PATCH), cwd=src)
+        run("bash", "build_sgl_deep_gemm.sh", cwd=src)
+        wheels = sorted((src / "dist").glob("*.whl"))
+        if len(wheels) != 1:
+            raise SystemExit(f"expected one sgl-deep-gemm wheel, got {wheels}")
+        run(
+            sys.executable,
+            "-m",
+            "pip",
+            "install",
+            "--no-deps",
+            "--force-reinstall",
+            str(wheels[0]),
+            cwd=src,
+        )
+
+    MARKER.write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {"key": key, "commit": DEEPGEMM_COMMIT, "module_sha256": sha256(module())}
+        )
+    )
+    print(
+        f"installed sgl-deep-gemm {DEEPGEMM_COMMIT[:8]} + MegaMoE decode patch (key {key})"
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Install Dynamo 1.6.0 ready to serve Kimi-K3.1 with SGLang, no per-job setup script needed.
+
+`ai-dynamo` 1.6.0 comes from PyPI. `ai-dynamo-runtime` (the Rust bindings, module dynamo._core)
+is rebuilt from ai-dynamo/dynamo v1.6.0 with the two patches in dynamo/:
+  0001  ai-dynamo/dynamo#15333 (rebase of #12191): keep the session id across the Python
+        chat-processor hop (--dyn-chat-processor sglang)
+  0002  carry the parent session id the same way and start a subagent on its parent's worker
+Both touch only lib/bindings/python and lib/llm. The features match the K3.1 GB300 image.
+
+The `ai-dynamo` Python package then gets the K3.1 edits of dynamo/dynamo_sglang_k31_patch.py
+(applied unmodified): DSA decode context parallel is accepted for
+KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration, and the model card is built from a staged copy whose config.json
+says model_type "kimi_k3", which Dynamo's tokenizer maps to the Kimi regex.
+dynamo/register_stage_model_card.py is appended to register.py so that copy is staged on first use
+instead of by a setup script. The setup script still runs cleanly on this image: it finds every
+edit already applied.
+
+Idempotent: a marker records this recipe's key and the sha256 of the installed dynamo/_core, so a
+rerun is a no-op unless the recipe changed or a reinstall replaced the runtime. The Rust toolchain
+and the source tree live in a temporary directory that is removed after the build.
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import sysconfig
+import tempfile
+from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, version
+from pathlib import Path
+
+DYNAMO_VERSION = "1.6.0"
+DYNAMO_REPO = "https://github.com/ai-dynamo/dynamo"
+DYNAMO_COMMIT = "701da25292ecca8f64d770cc0b17d389200019a1"  # tag v1.6.0
+FEATURES = "kv-indexer,slot-tracker,select-service,mm-routing,ais-forward-pass,request-trace-s3,nvtx"
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+PATCHES = sorted((HERE / "dynamo").glob("*.patch"))
+SGLANG_PATCHER = HERE / "dynamo/dynamo_sglang_k31_patch.py"
+STAGE_HOOK = HERE / "dynamo/register_stage_model_card.py"
+STAGE_HOOK_MARKER = "# K3.1 image: stage the K3.1 model card on first use"
+# libclang-dev: bindgen in the nixl-sys crate needs libclang.
+APT_PACKAGES = ["protobuf-compiler", "pkg-config", "libssl-dev", "libclang-dev"]
+
+SITE = Path(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"])
+CORE = SITE / "dynamo/_core.abi3.so"
+DYNAMO_SGLANG = SITE / "dynamo/sglang"
+MARKER = SITE / "dynamo/k31-dynamo.json"
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def run(*cmd: str, cwd: Path, env=None) -> None:
+    print("+", " ".join(cmd), flush=True)
+    subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, env=env, check=True)
+
+
+def installed(name: str):
+    try:
+        return version(name)
+    except PackageNotFoundError:
+        return None
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    inputs = [Path(__file__), *PATCHES, SGLANG_PATCHER, STAGE_HOOK]
+    key = hashlib.sha256(b"".join(p.read_bytes() for p in inputs)).hexdigest()[:16]
+    register = DYNAMO_SGLANG / "register.py"
+    if (
+        MARKER.exists()
+        and CORE.exists()
+        and register.exists()
+        and STAGE_HOOK_MARKER in register.read_text()
+    ):
+        marker = json.loads(MARKER.read_text())
+        if (
+            marker.get("key") == key
+            and marker.get("core_sha256") == sha256(CORE)
+            and installed("ai-dynamo") == DYNAMO_VERSION
+        ):
+            print(
+                f"Dynamo {DYNAMO_VERSION} with the runtime patches and K3.1 edits already installed (key {key})"
+            )
+            return
+
+    run("apt-get", "update", "-qq", cwd=Path("/"))
+    run(
+        "apt-get",
+        "install",
+        "-y",
+        "-qq",
+        "--no-install-recommends",
+        *APT_PACKAGES,
+        cwd=Path("/"),
+    )
+    run("bash", "-c", "rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*", cwd=Path("/"))
+    run(
+        sys.executable,
+        "-m",
+        "pip",
+        "install",
+        f"ai-dynamo=={DYNAMO_VERSION}",
+        cwd=Path("/"),
+    )
+
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        tmp = Path(tmp)
+        env = dict(
+            os.environ, RUSTUP_HOME=str(tmp / "rustup"), CARGO_HOME=str(tmp / "cargo")
+        )
+        env["PATH"] = f"{tmp / 'cargo/bin'}:{env['PATH']}"
+        run(
+            "bash",
+            "-c",
+            "curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs"
+            " | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain none --no-modify-path",
+            cwd=tmp,
+            env=env,
+        )
+        src = tmp / "dynamo"
+        run("git", "clone", "--quiet", DYNAMO_REPO, str(src), cwd=tmp)
+        run("git", "checkout", "--quiet", DYNAMO_COMMIT, cwd=src)
+        for patch in PATCHES:
+            run("git", "apply", str(patch), cwd=src)
+        run(
+            sys.executable,
+            "-m",
+            "pip",
+            "install",
+            "maturin[patchelf]>=1.0,<2.0",
+            cwd=tmp,
+        )
+        # rust-toolchain.toml pins the compiler; cargo installs it on first use.
+        bindings = src / "lib/bindings/python"
+        run(
+            sys.executable,
+            "-m",
+            "maturin",
+            "build",
+            "--release",
+            "--locked",
+            "--features",
+            FEATURES,
+            "--out",
+            str(tmp / "wheels"),
+            cwd=bindings,
+            env=env,
+        )
+        wheels = sorted((tmp / "wheels").glob("ai_dynamo_runtime-*.whl"))
+        if len(wheels) != 1:
+            raise SystemExit(f"expected one ai-dynamo-runtime wheel, got {wheels}")
+        run(
+            sys.executable,
+            "-m",
+            "pip",
+            "install",
+            "--no-deps",
+            "--force-reinstall",
+            str(wheels[0]),
+            cwd=tmp,
+        )
+
+    # The edits fail closed on a missing anchor; a model dir without config.json skips the staging
+    # step, which the appended hook does at runtime.
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        run(
+            sys.executable,
+            "-I",
+            "-B",
+            str(SGLANG_PATCHER),
+            str(DYNAMO_SGLANG),
+            str(Path(tmp) / "no-model"),
+            str(Path(tmp) / "staged"),
+            cwd=Path("/"),
+        )
+    register = DYNAMO_SGLANG / "register.py"
+    if STAGE_HOOK_MARKER not in register.read_text():
+        with open(register, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            f.write(STAGE_HOOK.read_text())
+    for pyc in (DYNAMO_SGLANG / "__pycache__").glob("*.pyc"):
+        pyc.unlink()
+
+    if installed("ai-dynamo-runtime") != DYNAMO_VERSION:
+        raise SystemExit(
+            f"ai-dynamo-runtime {installed('ai-dynamo-runtime')} installed, expected {DYNAMO_VERSION}"
+        )
+    MARKER.write_text(
+        json.dumps({"key": key, "commit": DYNAMO_COMMIT, "core_sha256": sha256(CORE)})
+    )
+    print(
+        f"installed Dynamo {DYNAMO_VERSION} with the runtime patches and K3.1 edits (key {key})"
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Rebuild FlashInfer's TRT-LLM MoE routing modules with the K3.1 DynBlock header.
+
+patch_flashinfer.py raises DynBlockKernelMaxNumExperts to 1024, but the prebuilt
+flashinfer-jit-cache modules were compiled with 512. This rebuilds every jit-cache copy of
+the modules below from the patched header, for its provider's architecture, and replaces
+it in place, so launches need no runtime switch and no on-site compile. Next to each module
+it writes MARKER (see verify_image.py), recording what it was built from.
+
+Each (module, architecture) builds in its own process, all in parallel: FlashInfer fixes
+the target architectures from FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST when it is imported.
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import sysconfig
+import tempfile
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from importlib import metadata
+from pathlib import Path
+
+MODULES = {
+    "fused_moe_trtllm_sm100": "gen_trtllm_gen_fused_moe_sm100_module",
+    "trtllm_gen_routing": "gen_trtllm_gen_routing_module",
+}
+MARKER = "k31-dynblock.json"
+HEADER = (
+    Path(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"])
+    / "flashinfer/data/include/flashinfer/trtllm/fused_moe/RoutingCustomPolicy.cuh"
+)
+
+_BUILD_ONE = """
+import shutil, sys
+from flashinfer.jit import fused_moe
+spec = getattr(fused_moe, sys.argv[1])()
+spec.build(verbose=False)
+shutil.copyfile(spec.jit_library_path, sys.argv[2])
+"""
+
+
+def header_sha256() -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(HEADER.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def arch_of(provider_id: str) -> str:
+    # FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST spelling: "sm103a" -> "10.3a"
+    major, minor, suffix = re.fullmatch(r"sm(\d+)(\d)([af]?)", provider_id).groups()
+    return f"{major}.{minor}{suffix}"
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import flashinfer_jit_cache
+
+    if "DynBlockKernelMaxNumExperts = 1024;" not in HEADER.read_text():
+        sys.exit(f"{HEADER} is not patched; run patch_flashinfer.py first")
+    marker = {
+        "DynBlockKernelMaxNumExperts": 1024,
+        "flashinfer": metadata.version("flashinfer-python"),
+        "header_sha256": header_sha256(),
+    }
+    jobs = [
+        (
+            Path(provider.jit_cache_dir) / module / f"{module}.so",
+            generator,
+            arch_of(provider.provider_id),
+        )
+        for provider in flashinfer_jit_cache.get_jit_cache_providers()
+        for module, generator in MODULES.items()
+        if (Path(provider.jit_cache_dir) / module / f"{module}.so").exists()
+    ]
+    if not jobs:
+        sys.exit(f"no jit-cache copy of {sorted(MODULES)} found")
+    # Each build is dominated by a few large translation units, so they run side by side,
+    # sharing the cores between them.
+    jobs_per_build = str(max(1, (os.cpu_count() or 1) // len(jobs)))
+
+    def build(job):
+        target, generator, arch = job
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as workspace:
+            env = dict(
+                os.environ,
+                FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=arch,
+                FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE=workspace,
+                MAX_JOBS=jobs_per_build,
+            )
+            built = Path(workspace) / target.name
+            subprocess.run(
+                [sys.executable, "-c", _BUILD_ONE, generator, str(built)],
+                env=env,
+                check=True,
+            )
+            shutil.copyfile(built, target)
+        (target.parent / MARKER).write_text(
+            json.dumps({**marker, "arch": arch}, indent=1)
+        )
+        return f"rebuilt {target} for {arch}"
+
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(jobs)) as pool:
+        for line in pool.map(build, jobs):
+            print(line)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Dynamo 1.6.0 SGLang edits for Kimi-K3.1 (DSA decode context parallel, kimi_k3 model card).
+
+Run by infra-d001v2-d002-dynamo-k31.sh under its flock; do not run directly.
+  python3 -I -B dynamo_sglang_k31_patch.py <dynamo/sglang dir> <model dir> <staged dir>
+
+Edits (each an exact anchor that must match once; already-applied text is detected and kept):
+  _compat.py  the earlier edit, unchanged: sglang_default_mla_attention_backend also defers
+              KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration to engine resolution.
+  args.py     K3.1 DSA DCP decode: _validate_mla_dcp_decode_backend returns early for
+              KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration (read via _compat.get_sglang_model_config).
+  register.py K3.1 model card: for KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration, _register_model_source_path
+              returns the per-job staged model-card directory.
+Staging (model card): <staged dir> holds a symlink to every non-weight file of <model dir> and a
+copy of config.json whose top-level model_type is "kimi_k3" (the only changed byte range).
+Prints one "key=value" line per item for the wrapper script; exits 1 with a message on failure.
+"""
+
+import json
+import os
+import shutil
+import sys
+import tempfile
+
+K31 = "KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration"
+STAGED_MODEL_TYPE = "kimi_k3"
+
+COMPAT_OLD = 'if "KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration" in ('
+COMPAT_NEW = (
+    'if {"KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration", "KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration"} & set('
+)
+
+ARGS_OLD = '''    unpack``, deep inside engine startup.
+    """
+    resolved = resolved_server_args(server_args)
+    # Prefill workers never run the DCP decode branch.
+'''
+ARGS_BLOCK = """    # K3.1 DSA DCP decode edit: Kimi-K3.1 decodes DCP through
+    # SGLang's DSA path, so its 'dsa' decode backend is not rejected, neither
+    # the CLI-time prediction nor the engine's resolved value.
+    try:
+        from dynamo.sglang._compat import get_sglang_model_config
+
+        _hf_config = getattr(get_sglang_model_config(server_args), "hf_config", None)
+        if "KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration" in (
+            getattr(_hf_config, "architectures", None) or []
+        ):
+            return
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logging.warning("K3.1 DSA DCP decode: could not read the model architecture: %s", exc)
+"""
+ARGS_NEW = ARGS_OLD.replace(
+    '    """\n    resolved', '    """\n' + ARGS_BLOCK + "    resolved", 1
+)
+
+REGISTER_OLD = """    weights = getattr(mc, "model_weights", None)
+    if weights:
+        return mc.model_path
+    return server_args.model_path
+
+
+def _build_media_decoder_and_fetcher():
+"""
+REGISTER_BLOCK = """# K3.1 model card edit: Dynamo's Rust tokenizer picks the
+# tiktoken BPE regex from config.json model_type and has none for Kimi-K3.1's
+# 'kimi_k31'. For KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration only, build the model card
+# from the per-job directory the worker setup script staged: a symlink to every
+# non-weight file of the model plus a config.json copy whose only change is
+# model_type 'kimi_k3' (identical tokenizer regex). SGLang keeps loading the
+# original model path.
+_K31_MODEL_CARD_STAGE_ROOT = "/tmp/k31-dynamo-model-card"
+_k31_model_card_original_source_path = _register_model_source_path
+
+
+def _k31_model_card_staged_dir() -> str:
+    job = os.environ.get("SLURM_JOB_ID") or "nojob"
+    return os.path.join(_K31_MODEL_CARD_STAGE_ROOT, f"mdc-src-{job}")
+
+
+def _k31_model_card_is_weight_file(name: str) -> bool:
+    return name.endswith(".safetensors") or name.endswith(".safetensors.index.json")
+
+
+def _register_model_source_path(
+    engine: Optional[sgl.Engine], server_args: ServerArgs
+) -> str:
+    source = _k31_model_card_original_source_path(engine, server_args)
+    try:
+        with open(os.path.join(source, "config.json"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            config = json.load(f)
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        return source
+    if not isinstance(config, dict) or "KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration" not in (
+        config.get("architectures") or []
+    ):
+        return source
+    staged = _k31_model_card_staged_dir()
+    try:
+        with open(os.path.join(staged, "config.json"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            staged_config = json.load(f)
+        expected = sorted(
+            name
+            for name in os.listdir(source)
+            if name != "config.json"
+            and not _k31_model_card_is_weight_file(name)
+            and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(source, name))
+        )
+        links = sorted(name for name in os.listdir(staged) if name != "config.json")
+        mirrors = links == expected and all(
+            os.path.islink(os.path.join(staged, name))
+            and os.path.realpath(os.path.join(staged, name))
+            == os.path.realpath(os.path.join(source, name))
+            for name in links
+        )
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"K3.1 model card: staged model card directory {staged} is unusable ({exc}); "
+            "was the model card staged in this job?"
+        ) from exc
+    if not mirrors or staged_config != {**config, "model_type": "kimi_k3"}:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"K3.1 model card: {staged} does not mirror {source} with model_type 'kimi_k3'"
+        )
+    logging.info("K3.1 model card: model card for %s built from %s", source, staged)
+    return staged

+REGISTER_NEW = REGISTER_OLD.replace(
+    "\n\ndef _build_media_decoder_and_fetcher():\n",
+    "\n\n" + REGISTER_BLOCK + "\n\ndef _build_media_decoder_and_fetcher():\n",
+    1,
+)
+
+
+def die(msg):
+    print(f"K3.1 Dynamo SGLang edits FAILED: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
+    sys.exit(1)
+
+
+def atomic_write(path, data, mode_from=None):
+    d = os.path.dirname(path)
+    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=d, prefix="." + os.path.basename(path) + ".infra.")
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as f:
+            f.write(data)
+            f.flush()
+            os.fsync(f.fileno())
+        os.chmod(tmp, os.stat(mode_from).st_mode & 0o7777 if mode_from else 0o644)
+        os.replace(tmp, path)
+    except BaseException:
+        if os.path.exists(tmp):
+            os.unlink(tmp)
+        raise
+
+
+def edit(path, old, new):
+    """Replace the single occurrence of old with new; detect an already-applied file."""
+    try:
+        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            text = f.read()
+    except OSError as exc:
+        die(f"cannot read {path}: {exc}")
+    n_old, n_new = text.count(old), text.count(new)
+    if n_old == 0 and n_new == 1:
+        return "already applied"
+    if n_old != 1 or n_new != 0:
+        die(
+            f"{path}: expected exactly 1 anchor and 0 patched blocks, found "
+            f"{n_old} anchor(s) and {n_new} patched block(s); first anchor line: "
+            f"{old.splitlines()[0]!r}"
+        )
+    patched = text.replace(old, new, 1)
+    if patched.count(new) != 1 or patched.count(old) != 0:
+        die(f"{path}: replacement did not produce exactly one patched block")
+    atomic_write(path, patched.encode("utf-8"), mode_from=path)
+    return "applied"
+
+
+def top_level_value_span(text, key):
+    """Return (start, end) of the string value of a depth-1 key in a JSON object text."""
+    depth, i, n, spans = 0, 0, len(text), []
+    while i < n:
+        c = text[i]
+        if c == '"':
+            j = i + 1
+            while text[j] != '"':
+                j += 2 if text[j] == "\\" else 1
+            token = text[i + 1 : j]
+            k = j + 1
+            while k < n and text[k] in " \t\r\n":
+                k += 1
+            if depth == 1 and token == key and k < n and text[k] == ":":
+                v = k + 1
+                while text[v] in " \t\r\n":
+                    v += 1
+                if text[v] != '"':
+                    die(f"top-level {key!r} is not a string")
+                e = v + 1
+                while text[e] != '"':
+                    e += 2 if text[e] == "\\" else 1
+                spans.append((v + 1, e))
+            i = j + 1
+            continue
+        if c in "{[":
+            depth += 1
+        elif c in "}]":
+            depth -= 1
+        i += 1
+    if len(spans) != 1:
+        die(
+            f"expected exactly 1 top-level {key!r} key in config.json, found {len(spans)}"
+        )
+    return spans[0]
+
+
+def is_weight_file(name):
+    return name.endswith(".safetensors") or name.endswith(".safetensors.index.json")
+
+
+def staged_config_bytes(src_text):
+    config = json.loads(src_text)
+    start, end = top_level_value_span(src_text, "model_type")
+    if src_text[start:end] != "kimi_k31":
+        die(f"top-level model_type is {src_text[start:end]!r}, expected 'kimi_k31'")
+    new_text = src_text[:start] + STAGED_MODEL_TYPE + src_text[end:]
+    if json.loads(new_text) != {**config, "model_type": STAGED_MODEL_TYPE}:
+        die("staged config.json differs from the original beyond model_type")
+    old_lines, new_lines = src_text.splitlines(), new_text.splitlines()
+    changed = [i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(old_lines, new_lines)) if a != b]
+    if len(old_lines) != len(new_lines) or len(changed) != 1:
+        die(f"staged config.json must differ in exactly one line, differs in {changed}")
+    return new_text.encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def stage_valid(model_dir, staged, names, config_bytes):
+    try:
+        entries = sorted(os.listdir(staged))
+        with open(os.path.join(staged, "config.json"), "rb") as f:
+            current = f.read()
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    if entries != sorted(names + ["config.json"]) or current != config_bytes:
+        return False
+    if os.path.islink(os.path.join(staged, "config.json")):
+        return False
+    return all(
+        os.path.islink(os.path.join(staged, n))
+        and os.readlink(os.path.join(staged, n)) == os.path.join(model_dir, n)
+        for n in names
+    )
+
+
+def stage(model_dir, staged):
+    cfg = os.path.join(model_dir, "config.json")
+    try:
+        with open(cfg, encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            src_text = f.read()
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        return "skipped (no config.json in model dir)"
+    config = json.loads(src_text)
+    if K31 not in (config.get("architectures") or []):
+        return "skipped (not KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration)"
+    config_bytes = staged_config_bytes(src_text)
+    names = sorted(
+        n
+        for n in os.listdir(model_dir)
+        if n != "config.json"
+        and not is_weight_file(n)
+        and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(model_dir, n))
+    )
+    if stage_valid(model_dir, staged, names, config_bytes):
+        return "already staged"
+    root = os.path.dirname(staged)
+    os.makedirs(root, mode=0o755, exist_ok=True)
+    tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=root, prefix=os.path.basename(staged) + ".tmp.")
+    try:
+        os.chmod(tmp, 0o755)
+        for n in names:
+            os.symlink(os.path.join(model_dir, n), os.path.join(tmp, n))
+        with open(os.path.join(tmp, "config.json"), "wb") as f:
+            f.write(config_bytes)
+        os.chmod(os.path.join(tmp, "config.json"), 0o644)
+        old = None
+        if os.path.lexists(staged):
+            old = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=root, prefix=os.path.basename(staged) + ".old.")
+            os.rename(staged, os.path.join(old, "d"))
+        os.rename(tmp, staged)
+        if old:
+            shutil.rmtree(old, ignore_errors=True)
+    except BaseException:
+        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
+        raise
+    if not stage_valid(model_dir, staged, names, config_bytes):
+        die(f"staged directory {staged} failed verification")
+    return f"created ({len(names)} symlinks + config.json)"
+
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) != 4:
+        die(
+            "usage: dynamo_sglang_k31_patch.py <dynamo/sglang dir> <model dir> <staged dir>"
+        )
+    pkg, model_dir, staged = sys.argv[1:]
+    print(
+        "compat="
+        + edit(os.path.join(pkg, "_compat.py"), COMPAT_OLD, COMPAT_NEW).replace(
+            " ", "_"
+        )
+    )
+    print(
+        "args="
+        + edit(os.path.join(pkg, "args.py"), ARGS_OLD, ARGS_NEW).replace(" ", "_")
+    )
+    print(
+        "register="
+        + edit(os.path.join(pkg, "register.py"), REGISTER_OLD, REGISTER_NEW).replace(
+            " ", "_"
+        )
+    )
+    print("stage=" + stage(model_dir, staged).replace(" ", "_"))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# K3.1 image: stage the K3.1 model card on first use, so Dynamo serves Kimi-K3.1 without a
+# per-job setup script. The layout matches dynamo_sglang_k31_patch.py: a symlink to every
+# non-weight file of the model plus a config.json whose model_type is "kimi_k3". A setup script
+# that stages it first still works; this only fills in a missing or stale directory.
+_k31_image_d002_register = _register_model_source_path
+
+
+def _k31_image_stage_model_card(source: str) -> None:
+    import shutil
+    import tempfile
+
+    try:
+        with open(os.path.join(source, "config.json"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            config = json.load(f)
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        return
+    if not isinstance(config, dict) or "KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration" not in (
+        config.get("architectures") or []
+    ):
+        return
+    staged = _k31_model_card_staged_dir()
+    expected_config = {**config, "model_type": "kimi_k3"}
+    names = sorted(
+        name
+        for name in os.listdir(source)
+        if name != "config.json"
+        and not _k31_model_card_is_weight_file(name)
+        and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(source, name))
+    )
+    try:
+        with open(os.path.join(staged, "config.json"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            current = json.load(f)
+        links = sorted(name for name in os.listdir(staged) if name != "config.json")
+        if (
+            current == expected_config
+            and links == names
+            and all(
+                os.path.realpath(os.path.join(staged, name))
+                == os.path.realpath(os.path.join(source, name))
+                for name in names
+            )
+        ):
+            return
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        pass
+    os.makedirs(_K31_MODEL_CARD_STAGE_ROOT, mode=0o755, exist_ok=True)
+    tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(
+        dir=_K31_MODEL_CARD_STAGE_ROOT, prefix=os.path.basename(staged) + ".tmp."
+    )
+    try:
+        os.chmod(tmp, 0o755)
+        for name in names:
+            os.symlink(os.path.join(source, name), os.path.join(tmp, name))
+        with open(os.path.join(tmp, "config.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            json.dump(expected_config, f, indent=2)
+        if os.path.lexists(staged):
+            old = tempfile.mkdtemp(
+                dir=_K31_MODEL_CARD_STAGE_ROOT,
+                prefix=os.path.basename(staged) + ".old.",
+            )
+            os.rename(staged, os.path.join(old, "d"))
+            shutil.rmtree(old, ignore_errors=True)
+        os.rename(tmp, staged)
+    except OSError:
+        # Another process staged it concurrently; the patched function validates the result.
+        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
+
+
+def _register_model_source_path(engine, server_args):
+    _k31_image_stage_model_card(
+        _k31_model_card_original_source_path(engine, server_args)
+    )
+    return _k31_image_d002_register(engine, server_args)

+"""Overlay FlashInfer main's Prims-TS sparse MLA onto the image's FlashInfer 0.7.2.
+
+The opt-in `prims_ts` DSA backend needs FlashInfer's `flashinfer/attention/prims_ts/` from main
+26bb6dc9 (flashinfer-ai/flashinfer #7410 and #7984); 0.7.2 ships an older copy that fails at
+startup. This replaces only that directory's Python files (CuTe DSL; no csrc, AOT or jit-cache
+module changes), the same tree as the earlier GB300 runs used. Everything else in
+FlashInfer, including the DynBlock-rebuilt modules, stays 0.7.2.
+
+Idempotent: a marker records the overlaid tree, so a rerun is a no-op unless a reinstall
+replaced the files. Needs network access only when it overlays.
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+import io
+import json
+import sysconfig
+import tarfile
+import urllib.request
+from importlib.metadata import version
+from pathlib import Path
+
+FLASHINFER_COMMIT = "26bb6dc93831c0192e524357dd25d7092917ae9b"
+FLASHINFER_BASE_VERSION = "0.7.2"
+SUBDIR = "flashinfer/attention/prims_ts"
+
+SITE = Path(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"])
+TARGET = SITE / SUBDIR
+MARKER = TARGET / "k31-prims-ts.json"
+
+
+def tree_sha256(root: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*.py")):
+        digest.update(str(path.relative_to(root)).encode() + b"\0" + path.read_bytes())
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    installed = version("flashinfer-python")
+    if installed != FLASHINFER_BASE_VERSION:
+        raise SystemExit(
+            f"flashinfer-python {installed} is installed; the Prims-TS overlay is validated on "
+            f"{FLASHINFER_BASE_VERSION} only"
+        )
+    if MARKER.exists():
+        marker = json.loads(MARKER.read_text())
+        if marker.get("commit") == FLASHINFER_COMMIT and marker.get(
+            "tree_sha256"
+        ) == tree_sha256(TARGET):
+            print(f"Prims-TS already overlaid from flashinfer {FLASHINFER_COMMIT[:8]}")
+            return
+
+    url = f"https://codeload.github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/tar.gz/{FLASHINFER_COMMIT}"
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=600) as response:
+        archive = tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(response.read()), mode="r:gz")
+    prefix = f"flashinfer-{FLASHINFER_COMMIT}/{SUBDIR}/"
+    members = [
+        m
+        for m in archive.getmembers()
+        if m.isfile() and m.name.startswith(prefix) and m.name.endswith(".py")
+    ]
+    if not members:
+        raise SystemExit(f"{SUBDIR} not found in flashinfer {FLASHINFER_COMMIT}")
+
+    for path in TARGET.rglob("*.py"):
+        path.unlink()
+    for member in members:
+        dest = TARGET / member.name[len(prefix) :]
+        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        dest.write_bytes(archive.extractfile(member).read())
+
+    MARKER.write_text(
+        json.dumps({"commit": FLASHINFER_COMMIT, "tree_sha256": tree_sha256(TARGET)})
+    )
+    print(
+        f"overlaid {len(members)} Prims-TS files from flashinfer {FLASHINFER_COMMIT[:8]}"
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Let FlashInfer's TRT-LLM MoE routing use the DynBlock kernel for K3.1's 896 experts.
+
+Raises DynBlockKernelMaxNumExperts from 512 to 1024 in the installed flashinfer headers;

+

+)

+    print(f"{HEADER}: already patched")
+elif text.count(OLD) == 1:
+    HEADER.write_text(text.replace(OLD, NEW))
+    print(f"{HEADER}: patched")
+else:
+    sys.exit(f"{HEADER}: expected exactly one {OLD!r}")

+"""Fail the image build when a compiled K3.1 component would silently fall back.
+
+Runs inside the image without a GPU, so it checks artifacts rather than loading CUDA code:
+- every op that our FlashMLA extension source registers is in the installed flashmla_ops;
+- the flashinfer DynBlock header patch is in place (patch_flashinfer.py), and every installed
+  copy of the modules that include it was rebuilt from this header for 1024 experts
+  (build_flashinfer_dynblock.py marker), so a flashinfer upgrade cannot silently undo it;
+- the FlashInfer Prims-TS overlay (overlay_flashinfer_prims_ts.py), the patched DeepGEMM build
+  (build_deepgemm.py) and the patched Dynamo runtime (build_dynamo.py) are installed and unchanged
+  since they were made;
+- the Rust TreeCore extension loads.
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import sysconfig
+from pathlib import Path
+
+SGLANG = Path("/sgl-workspace/sglang")
+SITE = Path(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"])
+
+errors = []
+
+source = (SGLANG / "python/sglang/kernels/aot/csrc/flashmla_extension.cc").read_text()
+ops = re.findall(r'm\.def\(\s*"(\w+)\(', source)
+module = (SITE / "sgl_kernel/flashmla_ops.abi3.so").read_bytes()
+missing = [op for op in ops if op.encode() not in module]
+print(f"flashmla_ops: {len(ops) - len(missing)}/{len(ops)} registered ops present")
+if not ops or missing:
+    errors.append(
+        f"flashmla_ops lacks {missing or 'all ops'}: the PyPI build is installed"
+    )
+
+header = (
+    SITE / "flashinfer/data/include/flashinfer/trtllm/fused_moe/RoutingCustomPolicy.cuh"
+)
+match = re.search(r"DynBlockKernelMaxNumExperts = (\d+);", header.read_text())
+print(f"flashinfer DynBlockKernelMaxNumExperts: {match and match.group(1)}")
+if not match or int(match.group(1)) < 896:
+    errors.append("flashinfer DynBlock routing does not cover 896 experts")
+header_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(header.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+modules = [
+    path
+    for name in ("fused_moe_trtllm_sm100", "trtllm_gen_routing")
+    for path in SITE.glob(f"flashinfer*/**/{name}.so")
+]
+if not modules:
+    errors.append(
+        "no installed fused_moe_trtllm_sm100 / trtllm_gen_routing module found"
+    )
+for module_path in modules:
+    marker_path = module_path.parent / "k31-dynblock.json"
+    marker = json.loads(marker_path.read_text()) if marker_path.exists() else {}
+    stale = (
+        marker.get("header_sha256") != header_sha256
+        or marker.get("DynBlockKernelMaxNumExperts") != 1024
+    )
+    print(
+        f"{module_path.relative_to(SITE)}: {'stale' if stale else 'rebuilt for 1024 experts'}"
+    )
+    if stale:
+        errors.append(
+            f"{module_path} was not rebuilt from the patched header (build_flashinfer_dynblock.py)"
+        )
+
+prims_ts = SITE / "flashinfer/attention/prims_ts"
+prims_marker_path = prims_ts / "k31-prims-ts.json"
+prims_marker = (
+    json.loads(prims_marker_path.read_text()) if prims_marker_path.exists() else {}
+)
+prims_digest = hashlib.sha256()
+for path in sorted(prims_ts.rglob("*.py")):
+    prims_digest.update(
+        str(path.relative_to(prims_ts)).encode() + b"\0" + path.read_bytes()
+    )
+prims_ok = prims_marker.get("tree_sha256") == prims_digest.hexdigest()
+print(
+    f"flashinfer Prims-TS: {'overlaid from ' + prims_marker['commit'][:8] if prims_ok else 'not overlaid'}"
+)
+if not prims_ok:
+    errors.append(
+        "flashinfer prims_ts is not the overlaid tree (overlay_flashinfer_prims_ts.py)"
+    )
+

+# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
+# Kimi-K3.1 serving image built from a sglang-k31 checkout (the build context), with the compiled
+# parts that the K3.1 optimizations rely on. Without them the server still starts and answers
+# correctly, only slower (silent fallback):
+#   1. Rust radix TreeCore   built by pip install -e "python" (needs .git: setuptools-scm version)
+#   2. FlashMLA flashmla_ops native 96-head sparse decode, sparse_decode_num_sm_parts and prefill
+#                            token packing; PyPI sglang-kernel 0.4.10 has none of them
+#   3. FlashInfer DynBlock   TRT-LLM MoE routing modules rebuilt for 1024 experts (K3.1 has 896)
+# verify_image.py fails the build if any of the three fell back. Three more parts back opt-in paths:
+#   4. FlashInfer Prims-TS   main 26bb6dc9's prims_ts/ over 0.7.2, for --dsa-*-backend prims_ts
+#   5. DeepGEMM              sgl-deep-gemm 0.2.3.post2 + DeepGEMM#130 (MegaMoE decode block_m)
+#   6. Dynamo 1.6.0          ai-dynamo-runtime rebuilt with the session-affinity patches and the
+#                            K3.1 edits to dynamo.sglang, so Dynamo+SGLang serves K3.1 as is
+#
+# Files: this Dockerfile, k31.Dockerfile.dockerignore and docker/k31-image/ (helper scripts and
+# the DeepGEMM and Dynamo patches). Everything else is fetched from public sources at pinned
+# commits: the base image, FlashMLA and CUTLASS (python/sglang/kernels/aot/cmake), flashinfer,
+# sgl-project/DeepGEMM, ai-dynamo/dynamo and rustup.
+#
+# Build from the root of a sglang-k31 checkout (keep .git), on amd64 or arm64 with BuildKit and
+# about 24 GB of free RAM; no GPU is needed:
+#   docker buildx build -f docker/k31.Dockerfile -t <tag> --load .
+# BASE_IMAGE must be a nightly whose commit is an ancestor of the checkout; update the default
+# when the tree moves to a newer upstream base. Lower FLASHMLA_JOBS (--build-arg) on hosts with
+# less RAM. The last step runs verify_image.py; it needs no GPU, so an image can be rechecked with:
+#   docker run --rm <tag> python3 /opt/k31-image/verify_image.py
+ARG BASE_IMAGE=lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-20261024-5994c559@sha256:40da9cac78a558237426971c048ab0f4f1a4b13bfb1b6e7a48d4d980e4163c8e
+FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}
+# Parallel nvcc jobs for flashmla_ops: 12 peaks at ~19 GB of RAM (amd64); the whole build peaks at
+# ~23 GB on arm64.
+ARG FLASHMLA_JOBS=12
+
+# Source: the checkout replaces the nightly's upstream tree at the same path, which the nightly's
+# editable install and verify_image.py expect. k31.Dockerfile.dockerignore (used instead of the
+# repo's .dockerignore) keeps .git and drops only build outputs.
+RUN rm -rf /sgl-workspace/sglang
+COPY . /sgl-workspace/sglang
+WORKDIR /sgl-workspace/sglang
+RUN git config --global --add safe.directory /sgl-workspace/sglang \
+    && git rev-parse HEAD > .k31-source-commit \
+    && pip install -e "python"
+
+# FlashMLA: only the flashmla_ops target of sgl-kernel, from this tree's aot sources (the build
+# applies apply_flashmla_patches.cmake and fails if a patch does not apply); it replaces the
+# PyPI wheel's module, the other sgl-kernel ops stay as installed.
+RUN cd /sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang/kernels/aot \
+    && CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 cmake -S . -B /tmp/flashmla-build -G Ninja \
+         -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
+         -DSKBUILD_SABI_COMPONENT=Development.SABIModule -DSKBUILD_SABI_VERSION=3.11 \
+         -DPython_EXECUTABLE="$(command -v python3)" \
+         -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="$(python3 -c 'import torch; print(torch.utils.cmake_prefix_path)')" \
+         -DSGL_KERNEL_ENABLE_SM100A=ON -DENABLE_BELOW_SM90=OFF -DENABLE_CCACHE=OFF \
+    && cmake --build /tmp/flashmla-build --target flashmla_ops -j "${FLASHMLA_JOBS}" \
+    && cp /tmp/flashmla-build/flashmla_ops.abi3.so \
+         "$(python3 -c 'import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"])')/sgl_kernel/" \
+    && rm -rf /tmp/flashmla-build
+
+# FlashInfer DynBlock: raise DynBlockKernelMaxNumExperts to 1024 in the installed headers and
+# rebuild the prebuilt jit-cache modules that include it, in place (no runtime env var needed).
+COPY docker/k31-image/patch_flashinfer.py docker/k31-image/build_flashinfer_dynblock.py \
+     docker/k31-image/overlay_flashinfer_prims_ts.py docker/k31-image/build_deepgemm.py \
+     docker/k31-image/deepgemm-mega-moe-decode-block-m.patch docker/k31-image/build_dynamo.py \
+     docker/k31-image/verify_image.py /opt/k31-image/
+COPY docker/k31-image/dynamo/ /opt/k31-image/dynamo/
+RUN python3 /opt/k31-image/patch_flashinfer.py \
+    && python3 /opt/k31-image/build_flashinfer_dynblock.py
+
+# Prims-TS, DeepGEMM and Dynamo: each script is a no-op when its marker matches what is installed.
+RUN python3 /opt/k31-image/overlay_flashinfer_prims_ts.py \
+    && python3 /opt/k31-image/build_deepgemm.py \
+    && python3 /opt/k31-image/build_dynamo.py
+
+# Fails the build if flashmla_ops lacks an op of this tree, a DynBlock module was not rebuilt, the
+# Prims-TS overlay, the DeepGEMM build or the patched Dynamo runtime is missing, or the Rust
+# TreeCore does not load.
+# Re-run any time: python3 /opt/k31-image/verify_image.py
+RUN python3 /opt/k31-image/verify_image.py \
+    && echo "sglang-k31 $(cat /sgl-workspace/sglang/.k31-source-commit)"

+"""DCP decode reduce as one push + combine kernel over a CustomAllReduceV2 push plane.
+
+Every DCP rank holds the attention partials of all heads over its KV shard and
+owns ``H / N`` heads of the result: the kernel pushes each peer's heads into its
+push slot over NVLink and combines its own heads by LSE weight in place of the
+pack + all-to-all + combine sequence. See ``csrc/dsa/dcp_push_combine.cuh``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import (
+    cache_once,
+    is_arch_support_pdl,
+    load_jit,
+    make_cpp_args,
+)
+from sglang.srt.utils.custom_op import register_custom_op
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.all_reduce import Communicator
+
+HEAD_DIM = 128
+# Push slot bytes per (row, local head): the bf16 payload and one 16 B LSE word.
+SLOT_BYTES_PER_ROW = HEAD_DIM * 2 + 16
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_module(world_size: int) -> Module:
+    args = make_cpp_args(world_size, is_arch_support_pdl())
+    return load_jit(
+        "dcp_push_combine",
+        *args,
+        cuda_files=["dsa/dcp_push_combine.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[("run", f"DcpPushCombineKernel<{args}>::run")],
+        extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3"],
+    )
+
+
+_COMM_MAP: dict[int, Communicator] = {}
+
+
+def register_comm(comm: Communicator) -> None:
+    """Register the communicator whose push plane carries the exchange (one per
+    world size: the op keys on it)."""
+    prev = _COMM_MAP.get(comm.world_size)
+    assert prev is None or prev is comm, (
+        f"a different communicator is already registered for world_size="
+        f"{comm.world_size}"
+    )
+    _COMM_MAP[comm.world_size] = comm
+
+
+def is_registered(world_size: int) -> bool:
+    return world_size in _COMM_MAP
+
+
+@register_custom_op(mutates_args=["out"])
+def _push_combine_op(
+    world_size: int,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    lse: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    lse_base_e: bool,
+) -> None:
+    _jit_module(world_size).run(_COMM_MAP[world_size], v, lse, out, lse_base_e)
+
+
+def dcp_push_combine(
+    world_size: int,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    lse: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    is_lse_base_on_e: bool = True,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Combine DCP partials ``v`` [B, H, 128] bf16 with LSE ``lse`` [B, H] fp32
+    across the ``world_size`` ranks of the registered communicator; returns this
+    rank's heads as [B, H / world_size * 128] bf16."""
+    batch, num_heads, head_dim = v.shape
+    assert head_dim == HEAD_DIM and num_heads % world_size == 0
+    out = v.new_empty((batch, num_heads // world_size * HEAD_DIM))
+    _push_combine_op(world_size, v, lse, out, is_lse_base_on_e)
+    return out

+"""Exact global top-k merge for DSA decode context parallelism; the algorithm
+is described in ``jit/csrc/dsa/dcp_topk_merge.cuh``."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit, make_cpp_args
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_dcp_topk_merge_module(
+    num_ranks: int, topk: int, cand_k: int, split: bool = False
+) -> Module:
+    args = make_cpp_args(num_ranks, topk, cand_k, int(split))
+    return load_jit(
+        "dcp_topk_merge",
+        *args,
+        cuda_files=["dsa/dcp_topk_merge.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[("dcp_topk_merge", f"DcpTopKMergeKernel<{args}>::run")],
+    )
+
+
+def dcp_topk_merge_buffer_numel(
+    num_ranks: int, max_rows: int, topk: int, cand_k: int
+) -> int:
+    """int64 entries of the symmetric buffer: two parities of max_rows row slots,
+    each holding every rank's candidates and this rank's full local top-k."""
+    return 2 * max_rows * (num_ranks * cand_k + topk)
+
+
+def dcp_topk_merge(
+    candidates: torch.Tensor,
+    global_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    page_table: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    buffer: torch.Tensor,
+    multicast_ptr: int,
+    peer_ptrs: torch.Tensor,
+    counters: torch.Tensor,
+    union_scratch: torch.Tensor,
+    out_slots: torch.Tensor,
+    out_fallback: torch.Tensor,
+    rank: int,
+    span: int,
+    cand_k: int,
+    split: bool = False,
+) -> None:
+    """Merge one batch of rows; every rank of the group must call it with the
+    same rows, in the same order.
+
+    ``candidates``: [rows, topk, 2] int32 (fp32 score bits, global position or
+    -1), this rank's local top-k. ``global_lens``: [rows] int32 visible keys of
+    each row. ``page_table``: [>= rows, pages] int32 widened page ids, row i
+    for row i. ``buffer``: the int64 symmetric buffer
+    (``dcp_topk_merge_buffer_numel``), ``multicast_ptr`` its multicast address,
+    ``peer_ptrs``: [num_ranks] int64 its address on every rank. ``counters``:
+    [max_rows] int64 calls per row slot, zero-initialized together with the
+    buffer on every rank. ``union_scratch``: [max_rows, num_ranks * topk] int64
+    working space of the fallback. ``out_slots``: [rows, topk] int32, this
+    rank's selected keys as widened slots ``page_table[p // span] * span + p %
+    span``, -1 after them. ``out_fallback``: [rows] int32, 1 where a
+    certificate failed.
+
+    ``split`` (KV replicated): rank q scored the 64-token pages p with
+    p % num_ranks == q, and every rank writes all selected keys, not only its own.
+    """
+    num_ranks = peer_ptrs.shape[0]
+    module = _jit_dcp_topk_merge_module(num_ranks, candidates.shape[1], cand_k, split)
+    module.dcp_topk_merge(
+        candidates,
+        buffer,
+        multicast_ptr,
+        peer_ptrs,
+        counters,
+        global_lens,
+        page_table,
+        out_slots,
+        out_fallback,
+        union_scratch,
+        rank,
+        span,
+    )

+"""Opt-in V32 prefill packing with per-token top-k ownership masks.
+
+Input top-k slots must be unique within each row. The union changes key order,
+so this path is disabled for deterministic inference. Q concatenation and tail
+padding are fused with union construction in the AOT FlashMLA extension.
+"""
+

+
+
+def flashmla_token_pack_available() -> bool:
+    from sgl_kernel import flash_mla
+
+    return flash_mla._flashmla_import_error is None and hasattr(
+        torch.ops.sgl_kernel, "flashmla_token_pack_prepare"
+    )
+
+
+def flashmla_kv_token_packed(q, q_rope, kv_cache, indices, sm_scale):
+    """Return [T, 1, H, 512], or None for unsupported widths/layouts.
+
+    The C++ launcher validates matching shapes, devices and index dtype.
+    """
+    if (
+        q.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+        or q.shape[0] == 0
+        or not 1 <= q.shape[1] <= 32
+        or q.shape[2] != (512 if q_rope is not None else 576)
+        or kv_cache.dtype not in (torch.uint8, torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        or kv_cache.shape[1:] != (64, 1, 656)
+        or kv_cache.shape[0] * 64 > 1 << 26
+        or not 1 <= indices.shape[1] <= 2048
+        or indices.stride(1) != 1
+    ):
+        return None
+    for part in (q, q_rope):
+        if part is not None and (
+            part.stride(-1) != 1
+            or part.stride(0) % 8
+            or part.stride(1) % 8
+            or part.data_ptr() % 16
+        ):
+            return None
+    packed_q, packed_indices, lengths = (
+        torch.ops.sgl_kernel.flashmla_token_pack_prepare(q, q_rope, indices)
+    )
+    out, _, _, _ = torch.ops.sgl_kernel.sparse_decode_fwd.default(
+        packed_q,
+        kv_cache,
+        packed_indices.unsqueeze(1),
+        lengths,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        512,
+        sm_scale,
+        "V32",
+        q.shape[1],
+    )
+    return out.view(-1, 1, q.shape[1], 512)[: q.shape[0]]

+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+# ROWS is not specialized: one compile serves every decode / verify batch size
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["ROWS"])
+def _indexer_q_quant_head_gate_kernel(
+    Q,
+    G,
+    Q8,
+    W,
+    ROWS,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    GATE_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    GATE_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    SOFTMAX_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    ROUND_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # Keep act_quant's arithmetic and the BF16 gate rounding point unchanged.
+    rows = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    cols = tl.arange(0, 128)
+    q = tl.load(
+        Q + rows[:, None] * 128 + cols[None, :], rows[:, None] < ROWS, other=0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    amax = tl.maximum(tl.max(tl.abs(q), 1), 1e-4)
+    scale = amax * (1.0 / 448.0)
+    if ROUND_SCALE:
+        scale = tl.exp2(tl.ceil(tl.log2(scale)))
+    quant = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(q / scale[:, None], -448.0), 448.0)
+    tl.store(Q8 + rows[:, None] * 128 + cols[None, :], quant, rows[:, None] < ROWS)
+    gate = tl.load(
+        G + rows // HEADS * GATE_STRIDE + rows % HEADS, rows < ROWS, other=0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    gate = (gate * GATE_SCALE).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(W + rows, gate * scale * SOFTMAX_SCALE, rows < ROWS)
+
+
+def indexer_q_quant_head_gate(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+    softmax_scale: float,
+    scale_fmt: str | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Kimi's no-RoPE indexer Q quantization and BF16 head-gate scaling.
+
+    Equivalent to act_quant(query, 128, scale_fmt), followed by
+    float(bf16(gate * heads**-0.5)) * q_scale * softmax_scale.
+    Query is contiguous [tokens, heads, 128]; gate may have a padded row stride.
+    """
+    assert query.is_cuda and query.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert query.ndim == 3 and query.shape[-1] == 128 and query.is_contiguous()
+    tokens, heads, _ = query.shape
+    assert gate.shape == (tokens, heads) and gate.stride(-1) == 1
+    assert gate.device == query.device and gate.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    q8 = torch.empty_like(query, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    weights = torch.empty((tokens, heads, 1), device=query.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    if tokens:
+        _indexer_q_quant_head_gate_kernel[(triton.cdiv(tokens * heads, 32),)](
+            query,
+            gate,
+            q8,
+            weights,
+            tokens * heads,
+            heads,
+            gate.stride(0),
+            heads**-0.5,
+            softmax_scale,
+            scale_fmt is not None,
+            32,
+            num_stages=0 if scale_fmt is not None else 2,
+        )
+    return q8, weights

+position ``p``, the keys at positions ``[p - window_left, p]``. Under DCP the
+cyclic layout puts position ``pos`` on rank ``pos % dcp_size`` at rank-local
+slot ``req_to_token[pos] // dcp_size`` (the layout of
+``create_mla_kv_page_table_for_dcp``). This kernel lists, per query row, the
+flat paged-cache rows of the window keys this rank owns, front-packed with -1
+after, plus their count: the block table and ``seq_lens`` of a trtllm-gen
+sparse MLA call. ``dcp_size == 1`` gives the plain (non-DCP) window.
+
+With a draft KV ring (``ring_rows_per_req``), a request's keys live in its own
+ring of rows instead of ``req_to_token`` slots: position ``pos`` sits at local
+row ``1 + req_pool_index * ring_rows_per_req + (pos // dcp_size) % ring_rows_per_req``
+(row 0 is the write sink). ``min_pos``, indexed by req pool index, raises each
+request's window start past the positions its ring does not hold.

+

+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl

+def mla_window_top_k(window_left: int, dcp_size: int) -> int:
+    """Index-list width: the most window keys one rank owns, padded to 4 for
+    trtllm-gen sparse MLA."""
+    owned = -(-(window_left + 1) // dcp_size)
+    return -(-owned // 4) * 4

+    indices_ptr,
+    counts_ptr,
+    req_to_token_stride,
+    ROWS_PER_REQ: tl.constexpr,
+    WINDOW_LEFT: tl.constexpr,
+    DCP_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    DCP_RANK: tl.constexpr,
+    PAGE_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    TOP_K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,

+"""K3 TP-sharded MoE front: fp32 multicast all-gather of the router + latent.
+
+Each rank multicast-stores its ``[M, N / world]`` block into every peer's
+CustomAllReduceV2 push workspace, where a Lamport spin assembles the full
+``[M, N]`` rows. Needs
+:func:`sglang.kernels.ops.communication.all_reduce_residual.register_comm` once
+beforehand (the same registration the push all-reduce uses).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import (
+    cache_once,
+    is_arch_support_pdl,
+    load_jit,
+    make_cpp_args,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.all_reduce_residual import _COMM_MAP
+from sglang.srt.utils.custom_op import register_custom_op
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+
+# Threads per block for a gathered output up to this many bytes; wider blocks
+# beyond. The grid is capped at one block per push counter, so wider blocks are
+# what keeps enough 16B spin loads in flight at large batches.
+_NARROW_BLOCK_MAX_BYTES = 256 * 1024
+_NARROW_BLOCK, _WIDE_BLOCK = 128, 512
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_module(n_local: int, world_size: int, block: int) -> Module:
+    args = make_cpp_args(n_local, world_size, block, is_arch_support_pdl())
+    return load_jit(
+        "kimi_k3_moe_front_ag",
+        *args,
+        cuda_files=["kimi_k3/comm/moe_front_ag.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[("run", f"K3FrontAllGather<{args}>::run")],
+        extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3"],
+    )
+
+
+@register_custom_op(mutates_args=["out"])
+def _moe_front_all_gather_op(
+    world_size: int, local: torch.Tensor, out: torch.Tensor, block: int
+) -> None:
+    _jit_module(local.shape[1], world_size, block).run(
+        _COMM_MAP[world_size], local, out
+    )
+
+
+def moe_front_all_gather(
+    world_size: int,
+    local: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    block: Optional[int] = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``out[:, r * n : (r + 1) * n] = local`` of rank ``r``, for every rank.
+
+    ``local`` is this rank's fp32 ``[M, n]`` block, ``n % 4 == 0``, 16B-aligned
+    rows that may be strided (a column slice of a wider GEMM output);
+    ``out`` is ``[M, world_size * n]`` fp32 (output-only). ``M * n * 4`` bytes
+    must fit one push slot. ``block`` (threads per block) defaults by size."""
+    if block is None:
+        narrow = out.numel() * out.element_size() <= _NARROW_BLOCK_MAX_BYTES
+        block = _NARROW_BLOCK if narrow else _WIDE_BLOCK
+    _moe_front_all_gather_op(world_size, local, out, block)
+    return out

+"""Coalesced row copies between interleaved CP rank and sequence order."""
+
+import math
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+# Row counts stay runtime arguments: they change with every batch, and specializing on
+# them would compile and load another kernel for each distinct token count.
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["input_rows", "rank_rows"])
+def _interleave_rows_kernel(
+    X,
+    Y,
+    input_rows,
+    rank_rows,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    CP_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    TO_RANK_MAJOR: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    col = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    if TO_RANK_MAJOR:
+        source = row % rank_rows * CP_SIZE + row // rank_rows
+    else:
+        source = row % CP_SIZE * rank_rows + row // CP_SIZE
+    value = tl.load(
+        X + source * WIDTH + col, (col < WIDTH) & (source < input_rows), other=0
+    )
+    tl.store(Y + row * WIDTH + col, value, col < WIDTH)
+
+
+def interleave_rows(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    cp_size: int,
+    output_rows: int,
+    *,
+    to_rank_major: bool = False,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Reorder contiguous rows; zero-pad sequence-to-rank copies when needed.
+
+    Rank-major input/output consists of equally sized, contiguous rank blocks.
+    ``output_rows`` trims rank padding when restoring sequence order. This is a
+    local copy and performs no communication.
+    """
+    assert x.is_cuda and x.is_contiguous() and x.ndim >= 2
+    assert cp_size > 0 and output_rows >= 0
+    rank_total = output_rows if to_rank_major else x.shape[0]
+    sequence_total = x.shape[0] if to_rank_major else output_rows
+    assert rank_total % cp_size == 0 and sequence_total <= rank_total
+    out = x.new_empty((output_rows, *x.shape[1:]))
+    width = math.prod(x.shape[1:])
+    if output_rows and width:
+        block = min(triton.next_power_of_2(width), 8192)
+        _interleave_rows_kernel[(output_rows, triton.cdiv(width, block))](
+            x,
+            out,
+            x.shape[0],
+            rank_total // cp_size,
+            width,
+            cp_size,
+            to_rank_major,
+            block,
+            num_warps=8 if block >= 2048 else 4,
+        )
+    return out

+"""A DFLASH draft block's KV ring locs in one launch, bitwise equal to
+``DFlashDraftKVRing.locs(req_pool_indices.repeat_interleave(block_size), positions)``."""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _dflash_ring_block_locs_kernel(
+    req_pool_indices_ptr,
+    positions_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    num_tokens,
+    req_pool_indices_stride,
+    positions_stride,
+    block_size,
+    rows_per_req,
+    dcp_size,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    offs = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = offs < num_tokens
+    req = tl.load(
+        req_pool_indices_ptr + (offs // block_size) * req_pool_indices_stride,
+        mask=mask,
+        other=0,
+    ).to(tl.int64)
+    pos = tl.load(positions_ptr + offs * positions_stride, mask=mask, other=0).to(
+        tl.int64
+    )
+    # Floor division and remainder as torch computes them (the divisors are positive).
+    q = pos // dcp_size
+    r = pos - q * dcp_size
+    q = tl.where(r < 0, q - 1, q)
+    r = tl.where(r < 0, r + dcp_size, r)
+    row = q % rows_per_req
+    row = tl.where(row < 0, row + rows_per_req, row)
+    local = 1 + req * rows_per_req + row
+    tl.store(out_ptr + offs, local * dcp_size + r, mask=mask)
+
+
+def dflash_ring_block_locs(
+    req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    block_size: int,
+    rows_per_req: int,
+    dcp_size: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Ring locs (int64 [num_tokens]) of ``positions``, ``block_size`` per request of
+    ``req_pool_indices`` in order."""
+    if req_pool_indices.dim() != 1 or positions.dim() != 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "DFLASH ring block locs take 1-D req_pool_indices and positions."
+        )
+    num_tokens = int(positions.numel())
+    if int(req_pool_indices.numel()) * int(block_size) != num_tokens:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"DFLASH ring block locs: {req_pool_indices.numel()} requests x block "
+            f"{block_size} != {num_tokens} positions."
+        )
+    out = torch.empty(num_tokens, dtype=torch.int64, device=positions.device)
+    if num_tokens == 0:
+        return out
+    block = min(1024, triton.next_power_of_2(num_tokens))
+    _dflash_ring_block_locs_kernel[(triton.cdiv(num_tokens, block),)](
+        req_pool_indices,
+        positions,

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Iterable, List, Sequence, Tuple
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+L2_PREFETCH_CHUNK_BYTES = 4096
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _l2_prefetch_module() -> Module:
+    return load_jit(
+        "l2_prefetch",
+        cuda_files=["speculative/l2_prefetch.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[("run", "L2PrefetchKernel::run")],
+    )
+
+
+def l2_prefetch_chunks(
+    spans: Iterable[Tuple[int, int]], chunk_bytes: int = L2_PREFETCH_CHUNK_BYTES
+) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
+    if chunk_bytes <= 0 or chunk_bytes % 16:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"chunk_bytes must be a positive multiple of 16, got {chunk_bytes}"
+        )
+    chunks = []
+    for addr, nbytes in spans:
+        if nbytes <= 0:
+            continue
+        lo, hi = addr & ~15, (addr + nbytes + 15) & ~15
+        chunks.extend((a, min(chunk_bytes, hi - a)) for a in range(lo, hi, chunk_bytes))
+    return chunks
+
+
+def build_l2_prefetch_table(
+    tensors: Sequence[torch.Tensor], chunk_bytes: int = L2_PREFETCH_CHUNK_BYTES
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if not tensors:
+        raise ValueError("no tensors to prefetch")
+    spans = [(t.data_ptr(), t.numel() * t.element_size()) for t in tensors]
+    rows = l2_prefetch_chunks(spans, chunk_bytes=chunk_bytes)
+    return torch.tensor(rows, dtype=torch.int64, device=tensors[0].device).reshape(
+        -1, 2
+    )
+
+
+def l2_prefetch(table: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    _l2_prefetch_module().run(table)

+"""Map K3 parser output back to generated tokens, without re-tokenizing it."""
+
+import re
+from bisect import bisect_right
+
+from sglang.srt.function_call.kimik3_format import (
+    MESSAGE_CLOSE,
+    RESPONSE_CLOSE,
+    RESPONSE_OPEN,
+    THINK_CLOSE,
+    THINK_OPEN,
+)
+
+_CHANNEL_MARKERS = re.compile(
+    b"|".join(
+        re.escape(s.encode())
+        for s in (
+            THINK_OPEN,
+            THINK_CLOSE,
+            RESPONSE_OPEN,
+            RESPONSE_CLOSE,
+            MESSAGE_CLOSE,
+        )
+    )
+)
+
+
+class KimiTokenProvenance:
+    def __init__(self, tokenizer):
+        # Both the HF Kimi tokenizer and SGLang's tiktoken wrapper expose the
+        # actual Encoding. Its byte API preserves partial UTF-8 tokens.
+        encoding = getattr(tokenizer, "model", None)
+        if not callable(getattr(encoding, "decode_single_token_bytes", None)):
+            encoding = getattr(tokenizer, "tokenizer", None)
+        self.decode = getattr(encoding, "decode_single_token_bytes", None)
+        if not callable(self.decode):
+            raise ValueError("K3 internal_content requires a tiktoken byte decoder")
+        self.raw = bytearray()
+        self.ids = []
+        self.ends = []
+        self.cursor = 0
+        self.reasoning_ranges = []
+
+    def append(self, token_ids):
+        for token_id in token_ids:
+            value = self.decode(token_id)
+            if not isinstance(value, bytes) or not value:
+                raise ValueError("Invalid token bytes for K3 internal_content")
+            self.raw.extend(value)
+            self.ids.append(token_id)
+            self.ends.append(len(self.raw))
+
+    def _ranges(self, source, strip_channels):
+        value = source.encode("utf-8")
+        if not value:
+            return []
+        tail = bytes(self.raw[self.cursor :])
+        segments = []
+        offset = 0
+        for marker in _CHANNEL_MARKERS.finditer(tail) if strip_channels else []:
+            segments.append((self.cursor + offset, self.cursor + marker.start()))
+            offset = marker.end()
+        segments.append((self.cursor + offset, len(self.raw)))
+        visible = b"".join(self.raw[a:b] for a, b in segments)
+        start = visible.find(value)
+        if start < 0:
+            raise ValueError("K3 increment has no matching generated token source")
+        end = start + len(value)
+        ranges = []
+        position = 0
+        for a, b in segments:
+            lo, hi = max(start, position), min(end, position + b - a)
+            if lo < hi:
+                ranges.append((a + lo - position, a + hi - position))
+            position += b - a
+        self.cursor = ranges[-1][1]
+        return ranges
+
+    def take(self, source, *, text=False, reasoning=False, replay_chars=0):
+        ranges = []
+        if replay_chars:
+            prefix = source[:replay_chars].encode("utf-8")
+            remaining = len(prefix)
+            for a, b in self.reasoning_ranges:
+                if remaining <= 0:
+                    break
+                end = min(b, a + remaining)
+                ranges.append((a, end))
+                remaining -= end - a
+            if remaining or b"".join(self.raw[a:b] for a, b in ranges) != prefix:
+                raise ValueError("K3 reasoning replay does not match its token source")
+            source = source[replay_chars:]
+        ranges.extend(self._ranges(source, strip_channels=text))
+        if reasoning:
+            self.reasoning_ranges.extend(ranges)
+        # Deduplicate token *positions*, not IDs: repeated generated tokens are
+        # distinct. A token spanning two increments legitimately appears in both.
+        positions = []
+        for a, b in ranges:
+            index = bisect_right(self.ends, a)
+            while index < len(self.ids) and (self.ends[index - 1] if index else 0) < b:
+                if not positions or positions[-1] != index:
+                    positions.append(index)
+                index += 1
+        if not positions:
+            raise ValueError("K3 non-empty increment has no generated tokens")
+        return [{"token_ids": [self.ids[i] for i in positions]}]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Host binding for the Kimi K3.1 dense/sparse decode megakernel."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from sglang.kernels.plugin_kernels.nvidia.spec import Step
+
+# a module import: binding imports this module back
+from sglang.srt.kernel_plugins.nvidia import binding as megakernel_binding
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_context import get_attn_backend
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_utils.capture_mode import (
+    get_capture_attention_variant,
+)
+
+
+class K31DecodeGraphVariants:
+    # Both variants run the plugin; the order matches the stock DSA capture order.
+    capture_labels = ("dense", "sparse")
+
+    def select(self, forward_batch):
+        lengths = forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu
+        if lengths is None or lengths.numel() == 0:
+            return "sparse"
+        return "dense" if int(lengths.max()) <= 2048 else "sparse"
+
+
+class K31DecodeHostBinding:
+    def __init__(self, model):
+        self.model = model
+        self.pools = megakernel_binding.MegakernelBinding(model=model)
+
+    def graph_variants(self):
+        return K31DecodeGraphVariants()
+
+    def pool_view(self, pool, req_pool):
+        return self.pools.preparation_view(pool, req_pool)
+
+    def can_run_graph(self, built, forward_batch):
+        # The graph runner pads live requests to a captured width before forward.
+        return (
+            forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
+            and 0 < forward_batch.batch_size <= max(built.widths)
+        )
+
+    def plan(self, built, input_ids, forward_batch, *args, **kwargs):
+        rows = int(input_ids.shape[0])
+        if (
+            not self.can_run_graph(built, forward_batch)
+            or rows not in built.widths
+            or input_ids.shape != (forward_batch.batch_size,)
+        ):
+            return None
+        if kwargs.get("get_embedding", args[0] if args else False):
+            return None
+        if (
+            kwargs.get("pp_proxy_tensors", args[1] if len(args) > 1 else None)
+            is not None
+        ):
+            return None
+        return Step(mode="decode", rows=rows)
+
+    def forward(
+        self, built, step, input_ids, positions, forward_batch, *args, **kwargs
+    ):
+        # optional plugin: imported only when the megakernel is installed
+        from sgl_nvidia_mega.kimi_k31.dsa_binding import (
+            IndexDecodeStep,
+            KdaDecodeStep,
+            MlaDecodeStep,
+            SparseDecodeStep,
+        )
+
+        backend = get_attn_backend()
+        rows = step.rows
+        full = backend.full_attn_backend.forward_metadata
+        linear = backend.linear_attn_backend.forward_metadata
+        # Captured graphs bake in their label; eager steps select from current lengths.
+        label = get_capture_attention_variant()
+        if label is None:
+            label = K31DecodeGraphVariants().select(forward_batch)
+        if label not in ("dense", "sparse"):
+            raise ValueError(f"unexpected K3.1 decode capture variant {label!r}")
+        schedule, plan = full.paged_mqa_schedule_metadata, full.topk_v2_plan
+        if schedule is None or plan is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "K3.1 sparse decode needs current paged-MQA schedule/top-k plan"
+            )
+        view = SparseDecodeStep(
+            MlaDecodeStep(
+                full.real_page_table[:rows],
+                full.cache_seqlens_int32[:rows],
+                forward_batch.out_cache_loc[:rows],
+            ),
+            KdaDecodeStep(linear.mamba_cache_indices[:rows]),
+            IndexDecodeStep(schedule, plan),
+            int(label == "sparse"),
+        )
+        view.validate()
+        lm = self.model.language_model
+        embeddings = lm.model.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+        hidden = built.run_decode(input_ids, embeddings, view)
+        self.pools.finish_step(forward_batch)
+        return lm.logits_processor(input_ids, hidden, lm.lm_head, forward_batch, None)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""SGLANG_ENABLE_NV_MEGA_RUNTIME_K31_GB_OPTIMIZATION for the process environment that
+CUDA and PyTorch read (SGLang's own children are environ.py defaults): set during
+server argument resolution, so every spawned process inherits it."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import os
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+GB_PROCESS_ENVS: dict[str, str] = {
+    "CUDA_MODULE_LOADING": "EAGER",
+    "PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF": "expandable_segments:True",
+}
+# A key also counts as set by the user when its alias is set.
+_ALIASES = {"PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF": "PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF"}
+_applied = False
+
+
+def _user_set(key: str) -> bool:
+    alias = _ALIASES.get(key)
+    return key in os.environ or (alias is not None and alias in os.environ)
+
+
+def apply_k31_gb_runtime_optimization() -> None:
+    """Under the switch, set every unset GB_PROCESS_ENVS key; set keys win, 0 included."""
+    global _applied
+    if _applied or not envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_NV_MEGA_RUNTIME_K31_GB_OPTIMIZATION.get():
+        return
+    _applied = True
+    applied, kept = [], []
+    for key, value in GB_PROCESS_ENVS.items():
+        if _user_set(key):
+            kept.append(key)
+        else:
+            os.environ[key] = value
+            applied.append(f"{key}={value}")
+    logger.info(
+        "SGLANG_ENABLE_NV_MEGA_RUNTIME_K31_GB_OPTIMIZATION: applied %s; kept user-set %s",
+        ", ".join(applied) or "none",
+        ", ".join(kept) or "none",
+    )

+    try:
+        return parallel.attn_dcp_size, parallel.attn_dcp_rank
+    except (RuntimeError, ValueError):
+        return 1, 0
+

+

+class K31SparseVerifyGraphVariants:
+    def __init__(self, query_width, split_min=0, context_length=None):
+        self.query_width = query_width
+        dcp = _attn_dcp()[0] > 1
+        # Split from this longest length (0: never); not under DCP (replicated index-K)
+        # or past the context length.
+        short = context_length is not None and context_length < split_min
+        self.split_min = 0 if dcp or short else split_min
+        if dcp:  # the dense core reads the whole latent cache
+            self.capture_labels = ("sparse",)
+        else:
+            self.capture_labels = ("dense", "sparse") + (
+                ("split",) if self.split_min else ()
+            )
+
+    def select(self, forward_batch):
+        if _attn_dcp()[0] > 1:
+            return "sparse"  # no dense variant under DCP
+        lengths = forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu
+        if lengths is None or lengths.numel() == 0:
+            return "sparse"
+        # seq_lens_cpu already includes this verify block.
+        longest = int(lengths.max())
+        if longest <= 2048:
+            label = "dense"
+        elif self.split_min and longest >= self.split_min:
+            label = "split"
+        else:
+            label = "sparse"
+        return label
+

+    def weights_view(self, context_length, *, query_width=8):

+        from sgl_nvidia_mega.kimi_k31.dsa.split import SPLIT_MIN

+        self.graph_policy = K31SparseVerifyGraphVariants(
+            query_width, split_min=SPLIT_MIN, context_length=context_length
+        )

+        records = []

+                    attention=record.attention

+    def pool_view(self, pool, req_pool):

+        tokens = req_pool.req_to_token

+            max(self.request_batches) * pages,

+
+    def graph_variants(self):
+        return self.graph_policy
+
+    def can_run_graph(self, built, forward_batch):

+    def forward(

+        backend = get_attn_backend()

+        scratch = select_verify_intermediate_state_indices(

+            forward_batch.req_pool_indices,
+            slots >= 0,
+            linear.req_to_token_pool.size,
+        )[:b]
+        if self.aux is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "K31 verify aux capture was not configured before graph warmup"
+            )
+        kda = KdaVerifyStep(

+        )
+        label = get_capture_attention_variant() or self.graph_policy.select(
+            forward_batch

+        if label not in self.graph_policy.capture_labels:
+            raise ValueError(f"unexpected sparse verify graph label {label!r}")

+        pages = full.real_page_table.shape[1]

+        size, rank = _attn_dcp()

+            )
+        view = SparseVerifyStep(
+            table,
+            full.cache_seqlens_int32[:b],
+            forward_batch.out_cache_loc[: step.rows],
+            kda,
+            self.aux[: step.rows],
+            b,
+            q,
+            step.rows,
+            causal_lengths=full.dsa_seqlens_expanded[: step.rows],
+            score_contexts=full.cache_seqlens_int32[:b]
+            .view(b, 1)
+            .expand(b, q)
+            .contiguous(),
+            score_schedule=full.paged_mqa_schedule_metadata,
+            topk_plan=full.topk_v2_plan,
+            sparse=int(label in ("sparse", "split")),
+            split=int(label == "split"),
+            **dcp,
+        )
+        lm = self.model.language_model
+        embeddings = lm.model.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+        hidden, aux = built.run_verify(embeddings, view)
+        return lm.logits_processor(input_ids, hidden, lm.lm_head, forward_batch, aux)

+"""DSA indexer top-k under decode context parallelism (DCP).
+
+The index-K cache is sharded by token: global position p of a request lives on
+rank p % N at local position p // N. Each rank selects the top-k of its own
+keys, the ranks all-gather (score, global position) candidates, and every rank
+selects the global top-k from them. A key in the global top-k ranks within the
+top-k of its own shard, so the merge is exact.
+
+Both selections run the v2 top-k kernel, which orders by score descending,
+then column ascending. Local columns are in global position order, and the
+merge scatters candidates into a row indexed by global position, so ties
+resolve by global position at both steps. With 8 or 16 ranks and multicast,
+decode rows instead merge in one kernel (``DcpTopKMerge``).
+"""
+

+from typing import Callable, Optional
+

+import triton.language as tl

+    dcp_topk_merge,
+    dcp_topk_merge_buffer_numel,
+)

+    candidates_cluster_size,
+    topk_transform_candidates_v2,
+    topk_transform_packed_v2,
+    topk_transform_paged_v2,
+)
+from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce_utils import (
+    is_one_nvlink_clique,
+)

+from sglang.srt.kernel_plugins.nvidia.binding import megakernel_enabled
