+_ZEROS: dict[torch.device, torch.Tensor] = {}
+_SIDE_STREAMS: dict[torch.device, torch.cuda.Stream] = {}
+
+
+def _side_stream(device: torch.device) -> torch.cuda.Stream:
+    stream = _SIDE_STREAMS.get(device)
+    if stream is None:
+        stream = _SIDE_STREAMS[device] = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device)
+    return stream
+
+
+class DcpCandidateAllGather:
+    """All-gather of the top-k candidates over the DCP group through torch
+    symmetric memory (NVLS multimem, as TorchSymmMemCommunicator does for
+    all-reduce): every rank writes its candidates into one symmetric output
+    buffer, rendezvoused once at init. Falls back to the group all-gather when
+    multicast is unavailable or the payload does not fit. Only the first
+    min(local_lens[row], topk) pairs in each row are valid.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, group, max_rows: int, topk: int):
+        import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
+
+        self.group = group
+        self.max_rows = max_rows
+        self.topk = topk
+        self.merge_buffer: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+        self.out: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+        self.prefix_handle = None
+        self.group_name = group.device_group.group_name
+        if not all(in_the_same_node_as(group.cpu_group)) and not is_one_nvlink_clique(
+            group.cpu_group, group.device
+        ):
+            return
+        prefix = group.world_size == 8 and topk == 2048 and get_platform().is_sm100
+        if prefix:
+            symm_mem.set_signal_pad_size(
+                max(symm_mem.get_signal_pad_size(), 32 * group.world_size * 4)
+            )
+        per_rank = max_rows * topk * 2  # int32 (score bits, position) pairs
+        out = symm_mem.empty(
+            group.world_size * per_rank, dtype=torch.int32, device=group.device
+        )
+        handle = symm_mem.rendezvous(out, self.group_name)
+        if handle.multicast_ptr != 0:
+            self.out = out
+            if prefix:
+                self.prefix_handle = handle
+
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        t: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        local_lens: torch.Tensor,
+        compact_prefix: bool = False,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        n = t.numel()
+        if (
+            self.out is None
+            or t.shape[1] != self.topk
+            or n * self.group.world_size > self.out.numel()
+        ):
+            return self.group.all_gather(t, dim=0)
+        out = self.out[: self.group.world_size * n]
+        if self.prefix_handle is None:
+            torch.ops.symm_mem.multimem_all_gather_out(t.view(-1), self.group_name, out)
+        else:
+            handle = self.prefix_handle
+            _gather_candidate_prefix_kernel[(8 if t.shape[0] <= 512 else 32,)](
+                t,
+                local_lens,
+                handle.multicast_ptr,
+                handle.signal_pad_ptrs_dev,
+                t.shape[0],
+                COMPACT_PREFIX=compact_prefix,
+                TOPK=t.shape[1],
+                RANK=handle.rank,
+                WORLD=handle.world_size,
+                BLOCK=512,
+                num_warps=16,
+            )
+        return out.view(self.group.world_size * t.shape[0], *t.shape[1:])
+
+    def merge_scores(self, rows: int, width: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # Like the candidate buffer, this scratch is consumed before the next
+        # merge. Reserve it during eager warmup and reuse it across graph batch
+        # sizes: a context-sized allocation per capture can exhaust VRAM.
+        # Never replace storage that a captured graph may still reference.
+        if (
+            self.merge_buffer is None
+            and 0 < rows <= self.max_rows
+            and not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+        ):
+            self.merge_buffer = torch.empty(
+                (self.max_rows, width), dtype=torch.float32, device=self.group.device
+            )
+        if (
+            self.merge_buffer is not None
+            and rows <= self.max_rows
+            and width <= self.merge_buffer.shape[1]
+        ):
+            return self.merge_buffer[:rows, :width]
+        return torch.empty((rows, width), dtype=torch.float32, device=self.group.device)
+
+
+_CANDIDATE_ALL_GATHER: Optional[DcpCandidateAllGather] = None
+
+
+def init_dcp_candidate_all_gather(max_rows: int, topk: int) -> None:
+    """Collective over the DCP group; call on every rank before CUDA graph
+    capture."""
+    global _CANDIDATE_ALL_GATHER
+    if _CANDIDATE_ALL_GATHER is not None:  # one buffer per process
+        return
+    _CANDIDATE_ALL_GATHER = DcpCandidateAllGather(
+        get_parallel().dcp_group, max_rows, topk
+    )
+
+
+_CANDIDATE_CLUSTER_FLOOR = 16384
+
+# Candidates per rank in the merge. Over 109824 decode rows of six real
+# workloads (32K and 100K contexts, all 24 DSA layers), a rank held at most 339
+# of a row's global top-2048 keys under DCP8, so 384 needs no fallback there.
+_DCP_MERGE_CAND_K = 384
+
+
+class DcpTopKMerge:
+    """Exact global top-k merge of decode rows in one kernel; see
+    jit/csrc/dsa/dcp_topk_merge.cuh. Needs 8 or 16 ranks (one warp each), top-k
+    2048 and multicast; ``usable`` is False otherwise. ``split``: candidates come
+    from the context-split verify indexer."""
+
+    def __init__(self, group, max_rows: int, topk: int, split: bool = False):
+        import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
+
+        self.rank = group.rank_in_group
+        self.max_rows = max_rows
+        self.split = split
+        self.buffer: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+        self.multicast_ptr = 0
+        self.peer_ptrs: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+        self.counters: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+        # 1 where a row's candidates could not certify the result (for tests)
+        self.fallback: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+        self.union_scratch: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+
+        world = group.world_size
+        # 16 ranks only on megakernel paths; stock DCP16 keeps the all-gather.
+        worlds = (8, 16) if split or megakernel_enabled() else (8,)
+        if world not in worlds or topk != 2048:
+            print_info_once(
+                "DSA DCP top-k merge off: it needs 8 or 16 ranks and top-k 2048"
+                if 16 in worlds
+                else "DSA DCP top-k merge off: it needs 8 ranks and top-k 2048"
+            )
+            return
+        if not all(in_the_same_node_as(group.cpu_group)) and not is_one_nvlink_clique(
+            group.cpu_group, group.device
+        ):
+            return
+        buffer = symm_mem.empty(
+            dcp_topk_merge_buffer_numel(world, max_rows, topk, _DCP_MERGE_CAND_K),
+            dtype=torch.int64,
+            device=group.device,
+        )
+        # Zero before the rendezvous: a peer pushes into this buffer as soon as
+        # its own rendezvous returns.
+        buffer.zero_()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize(group.device)
+        handle = symm_mem.rendezvous(buffer, group.device_group.group_name)
+        if handle.multicast_ptr == 0:
+            print_info_once("DSA DCP top-k merge off: no multicast")
+            return
+        self.buffer = buffer
+        self.multicast_ptr = handle.multicast_ptr
+        self.peer_ptrs = torch.tensor(
+            handle.buffer_ptrs, dtype=torch.int64, device=group.device
+        )
+        self.counters = torch.zeros(max_rows, dtype=torch.int64, device=group.device)
+        self.fallback = torch.zeros(max_rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=group.device)
+        self.union_scratch = torch.empty(
+            (max_rows, world * topk), dtype=torch.int64, device=group.device
+        )
+
+    def usable(self, rows: int) -> bool:
+        return self.buffer is not None and rows <= self.max_rows
+
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        candidates: torch.Tensor,
+        global_lens: torch.Tensor,
+        page_table: torch.Tensor,
+        out: torch.Tensor,
+        span: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        dcp_topk_merge(
+            candidates,
+            global_lens,
+            page_table,
+            buffer=self.buffer,
+            multicast_ptr=self.multicast_ptr,
+            peer_ptrs=self.peer_ptrs,
+            counters=self.counters,
+            union_scratch=self.union_scratch,
+            out_slots=out,
+            out_fallback=self.fallback[: out.shape[0]],
+            rank=self.rank,
+            span=span,
+            cand_k=_DCP_MERGE_CAND_K,
+            split=self.split,
+        )
+
+
+_TOPK_MERGE: Optional[DcpTopKMerge] = None
+
+
+def init_dcp_topk_merge(max_rows: int, topk: int) -> None:
+    """Collective over the DCP group; call on every rank before CUDA graph
+    capture."""
+    global _TOPK_MERGE
+    if _TOPK_MERGE is not None:  # one buffer per process
+        return
+    parallel = get_parallel()
+    group = parallel.dcp_group
+    # the kernel's rank must be the one the local candidates encode positions with
+    assert (group.world_size, group.rank_in_group) == (
+        parallel.attn_dcp_size,
+        parallel.attn_dcp_rank,
+    )
+    _TOPK_MERGE = DcpTopKMerge(group, max_rows, topk)
+
+
+def _zeros_i32(n: int, device: torch.device) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A read-only int32 zero vector of length n from a shared buffer (grown
+    outside CUDA graph capture only, so captured graphs never see it move)."""
+    buf = _ZEROS.get(device)
+    if buf is None or buf.numel() < n:
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            return torch.zeros(n, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        buf = _ZEROS[device] = torch.zeros(
+            max(n, 4096), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+    return buf[:n]
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _fill_visible_kernel(dense, dense_stride, lens, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
+    # -inf over [0, lens[row]), the only columns the top-k reads; a fixed
+    # number of programs per row strides over it
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    n = tl.load(lens + row)
+    base = dense + row.to(tl.int64) * dense_stride
+    for start in range(tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK, n, tl.num_programs(1) * BLOCK):
+        offs = start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+        tl.store(base + offs, float("-inf"), mask=offs < n)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _scatter_candidates_kernel(
+    gathered,
+    num_rows,
+    global_lens,
+    dense,
+    dense_stride,
+    WORLD: tl.constexpr,
+    TOPK: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+    COMPACT_PREFIX: tl.constexpr = False,
+):
+    # one program per (rank, row) block of candidates
+    src_row = tl.program_id(0)
+    row = src_row % num_rows
+    offs = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    # Prefix-only gathers leave the padding undefined, including on graph
+    # replays with shorter lengths. Never read it or scatter stale positions.
+    n = (tl.load(global_lens + row) + WORLD - 1 - src_row // num_rows) // WORLD
+    mask = offs < tl.minimum(n, TOPK)
+    base = gathered + src_row.to(tl.int64) * TOPK * 2
+    if COMPACT_PREFIX and n <= TOPK:
+        score = tl.load(base + offs, mask=mask, other=0).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
+        pos = offs * WORLD + src_row // num_rows
+    else:
+        score = tl.load(base + offs * 2, mask=mask, other=0).to(
+            tl.float32, bitcast=True
+        )
+        pos = tl.load(base + offs * 2 + 1, mask=mask, other=-1)
+    tl.store(
+        dense + row.to(tl.int64) * dense_stride + pos,
+        score,
+        mask=mask & (pos >= 0),
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _localize_compact_kernel(
+    slots,
+    slots_stride,
+    out,
+    out_stride,
+    lengths,
+    dcp_size,
+    dcp_rank,
+    TOPK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # owned slots (slot % N == rank) -> local rows slot // N at the front, in
+    # order, -1 after them; lengths[row] = number of owned slots
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, TOPK)
+    x = tl.load(slots + row.to(tl.int64) * slots_stride + offs)
+    own = (x >= 0) & (x % dcp_size == dcp_rank)
+    own_i = own.to(tl.int32)
+    n = tl.sum(own_i, axis=0)
+    dst = tl.where(
+        own, tl.cumsum(own_i, axis=0) - 1, n + tl.cumsum(1 - own_i, axis=0) - 1
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        out + row.to(tl.int64) * out_stride + dst, tl.where(own, x // dcp_size, -1)
+    )
+    tl.store(lengths + row, n)
+
+
+def dcp_localize_compact(slots: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Global top-k slots [rows, topk] -> (this rank's rows compacted to the
+    front, -1 after; [rows] counts) for FlashMLA's ``topk_length``."""
+    parallel = get_parallel()
+    rows, topk = slots.shape
+    out = torch.empty_like(slots)
+    lengths = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=slots.device)
+    if rows:
+        _localize_compact_kernel[(rows,)](
+            slots,
+            slots.stride(0),
+            out,
+            out.stride(0),
+            lengths,
+            parallel.attn_dcp_size,
+            parallel.attn_dcp_rank,
+            TOPK=topk,
+        )
+    return out, lengths
+
+
+def _local_candidates(
+    logits: torch.Tensor, local_lens: torch.Tensor, topk: int
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # [rows, topk, 2] int32 (fp32 score bits, global position or -1); row i of
+    # logits scores its request's local positions 0 .. local_lens[i]-1
+    parallel = get_parallel()
+    rows = local_lens.shape[0]
+    out = torch.empty((rows, topk, 2), dtype=torch.int32, device=local_lens.device)
+    if rows == 0:
+        return out
+    if logits.shape[1] == 0:
+        out[..., 1] = -1
+        return out
+    # v2 ragged top-k with the candidate epilogue: local positions ascend
+    # with global ones, so its tie order matches the merge's
+    topk_transform_candidates_v2(
+        logits,
+        local_lens,
+        out_candidates=out,
+        world=parallel.attn_dcp_size,
+        rank=parallel.attn_dcp_rank,
+        stable_ties=True,
+        cluster_size=candidates_cluster_size(rows),
+        cluster_floor=_CANDIDATE_CLUSTER_FLOOR,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+def dcp_global_topk(
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    local_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    global_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    page_table: torch.Tensor,
+    topk: int,
+    page_size: int,
+    plan: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    all_gather: Optional[Callable[[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor]] = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Decode / target verify: global top-k over the DCP group as widened KV
+    slots, -1 padded.
+
+    Row i is a query row (decode: request i; target verify: request i // n,
+    draft step i % n). ``local_lens`` / ``global_lens``: [rows] visible keys
+    of this rank / of the whole sequence for that row. ``page_table``: [rows,
+    pages] this rank's physical page ids, which are the widened page ids of the
+    row's request:
+    global position p maps to slot ``page_table[p // span] * span + p % span``
+    with span ``page_size * dcp_size``. ``plan``: the v2 top-k plan of
+    ``global_lens``. ``all_gather`` replaces the group all-gather (tests run
+    every rank in one process). Every rank must call this with the same number
+    of rows, also when it has no local keys.
+
+    With ``DcpTopKMerge`` the result holds only this rank's slots, which is all
+    ``dcp_localize_compact`` keeps.
+    """
+    parallel = get_parallel()
+    rows = local_lens.shape[0]
+    span = page_size * parallel.attn_dcp_size
+    global_lens = global_lens.to(torch.int32)
+    out = torch.empty((rows, topk), dtype=torch.int32, device=logits.device)
+    if rows == 0:
+        return out
+    if all_gather is None and _TOPK_MERGE is not None and _TOPK_MERGE.usable(rows):
+        candidates = _local_candidates(logits, local_lens, topk)
+        _TOPK_MERGE(candidates, global_lens, page_table, out, span)
+        return out
+    workspace = _CANDIDATE_ALL_GATHER if all_gather is None else None
+    compact_prefix = (
+        workspace is not None
+        and workspace.prefix_handle is not None
+        and rows <= workspace.max_rows
+        and topk == workspace.topk
+    )
+    if all_gather is None and workspace is not None:
+        all_gather = partial(
+            workspace, local_lens=local_lens, compact_prefix=compact_prefix
+        )
+    if all_gather is None:
+        all_gather = partial(parallel.dcp_group.all_gather, dim=0)
+
+    # Row i of `dense` holds the candidate scores at their global positions.
+    # Its -inf fill depends on the lengths only, so it overlaps the local top-k
+    # and the all-gather, which run on a side stream. The fill is captured
+    # first so that a CUDA graph continues on this stream after the join.
+    width = triton.cdiv(page_table.shape[1] * span, 4) * 4
+    dense = (
+        workspace.merge_scores(rows, width)
+        if workspace is not None
+        else torch.empty((rows, width), dtype=torch.float32, device=logits.device)
+    )
+    stream = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+    side = _side_stream(logits.device)
+    side.wait_stream(stream)
+    _fill_visible_kernel[(rows, 16)](dense, dense.stride(0), global_lens, BLOCK=2048)
+    with torch.cuda.stream(side):
+        candidates = _local_candidates(logits, local_lens, topk)
+        gathered = all_gather(candidates)
+    stream.wait_stream(side)
+    block = 1024
+    _scatter_candidates_kernel[(gathered.shape[0], triton.cdiv(topk, block))](
+        gathered,
+        rows,
+        global_lens,
+        dense,
+        dense.stride(0),
+        WORLD=parallel.attn_dcp_size,
+        COMPACT_PREFIX=compact_prefix,
+        TOPK=topk,
+        BLOCK=block,
+    )
+    topk_transform_paged_v2(
+        dense, global_lens, page_table, out, span, plan, stable_ties=True
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+def dcp_all_visible(
+    global_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    page_table: torch.Tensor,
+    topk: int,
+    page_size: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Decode / target verify: every visible position as widened KV slots, for
+    rows that see at most ``topk`` keys (the indexer's k-only path), -1 padded."""
+    span = page_size * get_parallel().attn_dcp_size
+    rows = global_lens.shape[0]
+    scores = torch.zeros((rows, topk), dtype=torch.float32, device=global_lens.device)
+    out = torch.empty((rows, topk), dtype=torch.int32, device=global_lens.device)
+    if rows == 0:
+        return out
+    topk_transform_packed_v2(
+        scores,
+        global_lens.to(torch.int32),
+        page_table,
+        out,
+        span,
+        row_starts=_zeros_i32(rows, global_lens.device),
+        stable_ties=True,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+def dcp_gather_request_rows(
+    local_rows: torch.Tensor, seq_lens_cpu: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Prefill: every request's cache rows from all ranks, in position order.
+
+    ``local_rows``: [sum of this rank's shares, W] uint8, request by request
+    in local position order. Returns [sum(seq_lens), W]: request after
+    request, the rows of positions 0..seq_len-1 (the layout of the ragged
+    top-k indices).
+    """
+    return all_gather_kv_cache_for_dcp(local_rows, local_rows[:, :0], seq_lens_cpu)

+"""FlashInfer Prims-TS sparse MLA for the DSA backend (``prims_ts``).
+
+The kernel reads the raw FP8 MLA cache rows that the ``trtllm`` DSA backend writes
+(576 B/token: 512 NoPE + 64 RoPE E4M3, one per-tensor scale) with an E4M3 query
+and FP8 QK/PV MMA, and returns BF16 output with a natural-log LSE. It shares the
+``trtllm`` route's query preparation, KV store, top-k transforms and DCP slot
+localization; only the attention kernel differs.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+# Decode/verify graphs plan their exact row count; eager batches above this share
+# power-of-two capacity plans, so prefill chunks do not plan one kernel per size.
+_EXACT_PLAN_MAX_ROWS = 1024
+
+
+def _plan_capacity(rows: int) -> Optional[int]:
+    """None plans exactly ``rows`` fixed rows; otherwise the packed row capacity."""
+    if rows <= _EXACT_PLAN_MAX_ROWS:
+        return None
+    return 1 << (rows - 1).bit_length()
+
+
+def check_prims_ts_sparse_mla_support(
+    *, device: torch.device, num_heads: int, kv_lora_rank: int, qk_rope_head_dim: int
+) -> None:
+    """Fail at startup, not at the first forward, when the installed FlashInfer
+    cannot plan the D576 native-E4M3 sparse MLA this backend needs."""
+    if (kv_lora_rank, qk_rope_head_dim) != (512, 64):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "--dsa-*-backend prims_ts supports D576 MLA "
+            f"(kv_lora_rank 512, qk_rope_head_dim 64); got {kv_lora_rank}, "

+### GPU staging capacity
+
+For Linker deployments using a transport that stages GPU data through host memory
+(such as TCP), set `local_buffer_size` in the SGLang Mooncake JSON configuration or
+storage extra configuration. The value is a non-negative byte count and defaults
+to 16 MiB. Size it for concurrent reads and writes, including large recurrent
+state objects. This is per-client transient memory, separate from the shared
+`global_segment_size`; include both in the host memory budget.
+
+### Direct Linker with PCP and RDMA
+
+The direct Linker requires `--pp-size 1`; pipeline parallelism is not supported.
+For K31's hybrid DSA/KDA pools, interleave PCP keeps complete DSA KV and
+indexer pages on each GPU. The direct Linker shares these objects across
+replicated PCP and attention-TP ranks, with one writer per shared pool.
+Every rank reads the shared objects into its own GPU buffers. KDA state keeps
+rank-specific objects; replicated MLA draft pools also share across attention-TP
+ranks. This deduplicates L3 storage, not GPU allocations.
+Use a distinct `extra_backend_tag` for each model/draft revision, dtype, page
+layout and parallel topology; the shared keys do not enable cross-topology reuse.
+
+Native Mooncake range GETs can issue RDMA READs from remote host segments
+directly into registered GPU buffers. To keep this L3 engine independent of a
+PD NVLink engine, set `SGLANG_HICACHE_MOONCAKE_REUSE_TE=0` and
+`MC_MS_AUTO_DISC=0`, choose `protocol: "rdma"` and explicit `device_name` HCAs,
+and set `global_segment_size: 0` on Prefill consumers. Retain a small
+`local_buffer_size` (the default 16 MiB) for the Store's bytes-based startup
+check. Direct Linker KV reads use registered GPU pointers and do not stage
+through this buffer.
+Run separate host providers on both Prefill and Decode nodes; Decode does not
+need a Linker client. Unset `MC_FORCE_TCP` entirely.
+
+The native SDK and GPU allocation must support GPU memory registration. On
+DMA-BUF deployments without `nvidia-peermem`, use `WITH_NVIDIA_PEERMEM=0`.
+Choose the platform's working GID. On isolated NIC rails with matching HCA
+names, `MC_ENABLE_DEST_DEVICE_AFFINITY=1` keeps remote host reads on the same
+rail; GPU-location HCA peer affinity does not cover host source segments.
+Verify an actual remote-host-to-GPU read before serving;
+successful host registration alone does not establish GPUDirect RDMA support.

+"""SGLANG_OPT_DFLASH_DRAFT_L2_PREFETCH: a branch forked at the draft CUDA graph's head
+prefetches the draft's small non-Linear tensors into L2; the graph's tail joins it."""
+
+from itertools import chain
+from typing import List
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.l2_prefetch import (
+    build_l2_prefetch_table,
+    l2_prefetch,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.linear import LinearBase
+
+_L2_PREFETCH_MAX_TENSOR_BYTES = 4 << 20
+
+
+def _own_tensors(module):
+    attrs = (v for v in vars(module).values() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor))
+    return chain(module.parameters(recurse=False), module.buffers(recurse=False), attrs)
+
+
+def draft_l2_prefetch_tensors(draft_model) -> List[torch.Tensor]:
+    tensors, seen = [], set()
+
+    def add(t):
+        if (
+            t.is_cuda
+            and t.numel() * t.element_size() <= _L2_PREFETCH_MAX_TENSOR_BYTES
+            and t.data_ptr() not in seen
+        ):
+            seen.add(t.data_ptr())
+            tensors.append(t)
+
+    for layer in draft_model.layers:
+        for module in layer.modules():
+            if isinstance(module, LinearBase):
+                continue
+            for t in _own_tensors(module):
+                add(t)
+    for module in draft_model.norm.modules():
+        for t in _own_tensors(module):
+            add(t)
+    return tensors
+
+
+class DraftL2Prefetch:
+    def __init__(self, tensors: List[torch.Tensor]):
+        self.tensors = tensors
+        self.table = build_l2_prefetch_table(tensors)
+        self._stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=self.table.device)
+
+    def capture_head_hook(self, runner, forward_batch) -> None:
+        del runner, forward_batch
+        self._stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self._stream):
+            l2_prefetch(self.table)
+
+    def capture_tail_hook(self, runner, out, forward_batch, num_tokens) -> None:
+        del runner, out, forward_batch, num_tokens
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(self._stream)

+"""A per-request ring of draft KV rows for an all-sliding-window MLA DFLASH draft.
+
+The draft attends only to the last ``window_left + 1`` positions, and the KV of
+a position depends on that position's target hidden state alone. So instead of
+one draft row per target slot, each request owns ``rows_per_req`` rows per DCP
+rank, enough for the window plus a verify block:
+
+    local row(req, pos) = 1 + req * rows_per_req + (pos // dcp) % rows_per_req
+    loc(req, pos)       = local row * dcp + pos % dcp
+
+``loc`` keeps the DCP owner rule of the shared pool (``loc % dcp`` is the owner
+rank, the row is ``loc // dcp``), so the existing sharded writers apply as is.
+Row 0 is the write sink. The window kernel computes the same rows directly
+(``mla_window_sparse_indices(ring_rows_per_req=...)``).
+
+A request's ring holds no positions from before its first prefill chunk (its
+prefix-cache hit) or from a previous request in the same req pool slot;
+``min_pos`` floors the window there.
+
+Under PD disaggregation prefill sends a request's last window of ring rows
+(``transfer_rows``, positionally matched like DeepSeek-V4's SWA ring) and its
+``min_pos`` row; a decode rank keeps the positions it owns.
+"""
+
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dflash_ring_locs import dflash_ring_block_locs
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+
+
+def draft_kv_ring_enabled() -> bool:
+    """The flag as resolved at startup (``_resolve_dflash_draft_kv_ring``)."""
+    return envs.SGLANG_DFLASH_DRAFT_KV_RING.get()
+
+
+def draft_kv_ring_unsupported_reason(
+    draft_hf_config, *, draft_backend: Optional[str], draft_window_size
+) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Why a draft KV ring cannot serve this DFLASH draft, or None if it can."""
+    from sglang.srt.speculative.dflash_utils import (
+        get_dflash_layer_types,
+        is_dflash_mla_draft_config,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.speculative.draft_worker_common import (
+        DFLASH_MLA_ONLY_DRAFT_BACKENDS,
+    )
+
+    if not is_dflash_mla_draft_config(draft_hf_config):
+        return "the draft is not MLA"
+    layer_types = get_dflash_layer_types(draft_hf_config)
+    if not layer_types or any(t != "sliding_attention" for t in layer_types):
+        return f"not every draft layer is sliding_attention ({layer_types})"
+    if draft_backend not in DFLASH_MLA_ONLY_DRAFT_BACKENDS:
+        return f"draft backend {draft_backend!r} has no window index path"
+    if draft_window_size is not None:
+        return "--speculative-draft-window-size keeps the compact draft table"
+    return None
+
+
+def draft_kv_ring_window_left(draft_hf_config) -> int:
+    """The draft's sliding window (window_left); a ring needs every layer to slide."""
+    from sglang.srt.speculative.dflash_utils import (
+        get_dflash_attention_sliding_window_size,
+        get_dflash_layer_types,
+    )
+
+    layer_types = get_dflash_layer_types(draft_hf_config)
+    if not layer_types or any(t != "sliding_attention" for t in layer_types):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "SGLANG_DFLASH_DRAFT_KV_RING needs a draft whose every layer is "
+            f"sliding_attention; got layer_types={layer_types}."
+        )
+    return get_dflash_attention_sliding_window_size(draft_hf_config)
+
+
+def draft_kv_ring_rows_per_req(
+    *, window_left: int, block_size: int, dcp_size: int
+) -> int:
+    """Rows per request per DCP rank: a window plus one verify block, plus one
+    row so the block never lands on a key the window still reads."""
+    span = window_left + 1 + block_size
+    return -(-span // dcp_size) + 1
+
+
+def draft_kv_ring_pool_rows(
+    *, req_pool_rows: int, rows_per_req: int, page_size: int
+) -> int:
+    rows = 1 + req_pool_rows * rows_per_req
+    return -(-rows // page_size) * page_size
+
+
+class DFlashDraftKVRing:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        rows_per_req: int,
+        dcp_size: int,
+        req_pool_rows: int,
+        device: torch.device,
+        window_left: int = 0,
+        dcp_rank: int = 0,
+        pool=None,
+        mem_pool: Optional[torch.cuda.MemPool] = None,
+    ):
+        self.rows_per_req = rows_per_req
+        self.dcp_size = dcp_size
+        self.window_left = window_left
+        self.dcp_rank = dcp_rank
+        self.pool = pool
+        # Positions a ring holds without wrapping onto each other.
+        self.span = rows_per_req * dcp_size
+        # PD writes min_pos rows remotely; Mooncake's NVLink transport only
+        # reaches memory from the KV pools' cuMemCreate pool.
+        with torch.cuda.use_mem_pool(mem_pool) if mem_pool else nullcontext():
+            self.min_pos = torch.zeros(req_pool_rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self._floor_rids: Dict[int, str] = {}
+        self._fused_block_locs = envs.SGLANG_OPT_DFLASH_RING_LOCS_FUSED.get()
+
+    def locs(
+        self, req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Ring locs of ``positions``, ``req_pool_indices`` given per row."""
+        positions = positions.to(torch.int64)
+        local = (
+            1
+            + req_pool_indices.to(torch.int64) * self.rows_per_req
+            + torch.remainder(positions // self.dcp_size, self.rows_per_req)
+        )
+        return local * self.dcp_size + torch.remainder(positions, self.dcp_size)
+
+    def block_locs(
+        self, req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor, block_size: int
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Ring locs of a draft block: ``block_size`` positions per request."""
+        if not self._fused_block_locs:
+            return self.locs(req_pool_indices.repeat_interleave(block_size), positions)
+
+        return dflash_ring_block_locs(
+            req_pool_indices,
+            positions,
+            block_size=block_size,
+            rows_per_req=self.rows_per_req,
+            dcp_size=self.dcp_size,
+        )
+
+    def extend_locs(
+        self,
+        *,
+        req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        extend_lens: torch.Tensor,
+        seq_ends: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Ring locs for one extend's tokens (request-major). A chunk longer than
+        the ring wraps onto itself; only its last ``span`` positions, the ones a
+        later window can read, keep a ring row, the rest go to the sink."""
+        num_tokens = int(positions.numel())
+        req_of_token = torch.repeat_interleave(
+            req_pool_indices.to(torch.int64), extend_lens, output_size=num_tokens
+        )
+        end_of_token = torch.repeat_interleave(
+            seq_ends.to(torch.int64), extend_lens, output_size=num_tokens
+        )
+        locs = self.locs(req_of_token, positions)
+        keep = positions.to(torch.int64) >= end_of_token - self.span
+        return torch.where(keep, locs, torch.zeros_like(locs))
+
+    def record_floors(self, reqs, prefix_lens) -> None:
+        """On a request's first extend, its prefix-cache hit length becomes the
+        earliest position its window may read."""
+        slots, floors = [], []
+        for req, prefix_len in zip(reqs, prefix_lens):
+            slot = req.kv.req_pool_idx
+            if self._floor_rids.get(slot) != req.rid:
+                self._floor_rids[slot] = req.rid
+                slots.append(slot)
+                floors.append(int(prefix_len))
+        if slots:
+            self.min_pos[
+                torch.tensor(slots, dtype=torch.int64).to(
+                    self.min_pos.device, non_blocking=True
+                )
+            ] = torch.tensor(floors, dtype=torch.int32).to(
+                self.min_pos.device, non_blocking=True
+            )
+
+    def transfer_rows(self, req_pool_idx: int, seq_len: int) -> np.ndarray:
+        """This rank's ring rows of the last window before ``seq_len``, in
+        position order; row 0 (the sink) for a position another rank owns."""
+        positions = np.arange(
+            max(0, seq_len - self.window_left - 1), seq_len, dtype=np.int64
+        )
+        rows = (
+            1
+            + req_pool_idx * self.rows_per_req
+            + (positions // self.dcp_size) % self.rows_per_req
+        )
+        rows[positions % self.dcp_size != self.dcp_rank] = 0
+        return rows.astype(np.int32)
+
+    def reset_floor(self, req_pool_idx: int, seq_len: int) -> None:
+        """PD decode, at preallocation: no draft context until prefill's floor
+        row lands, so a prefill that ships no ring leaves an empty window
+        rather than a stale one."""
+        self.min_pos[req_pool_idx].fill_(seq_len)
+
+    def ring_buf_infos(self) -> Tuple[List[int], List[int], List[int]]:
+        """The draft pool's buffers with one item per ring row."""
+        ptrs, lens, item_lens = self.pool.get_contiguous_buf_infos()
+        return ptrs, lens, [n // self.pool.page_size for n in item_lens]
+
+    def floor_buf_infos(self) -> Tuple[List[int], List[int], List[int]]:
+        """``min_pos`` with one item per req pool row."""
+        return (
+            [self.min_pos.data_ptr()],
+            [self.min_pos.nbytes],
+            [self.min_pos.element_size()],
+        )
+
+
+_active_ring: Optional[DFlashDraftKVRing] = None
+
+
+def set_draft_kv_ring(ring: Optional[DFlashDraftKVRing]) -> None:
+    global _active_ring
+    _active_ring = ring
+
+
+def get_draft_kv_ring() -> Optional[DFlashDraftKVRing]:
+    """This process's draft KV ring, for PD state registration and payloads."""
+    return _active_ring

+"""Simulated DFLASH acceptance lengths (SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN) for a device reader.
+
+Draws stay on the host CPU RNG, so the device and eager paths see one sequence.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+
+class SimAccLenRing:
+    """Stages host-drawn commit lengths into ``device_len`` (int32 [1]).
+
+    A pinned slot is rewritten only after its previous non-blocking copy completes."""
+
+    SLOTS = 4
+
+    def __init__(self, device: torch.device):
+        self.device = torch.device(device)
+        cuda = self.device.type == "cuda"
+        self.host = torch.zeros(self.SLOTS, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=cuda)
+        self.device_len = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device)
+        self._copied: list = [
+            None
+        ] * self.SLOTS  # each slot's last copy-done event (CUDA)
+        self.staged = 0
+
+    def stage(self, length: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Queue ``length`` into ``device_len`` on the current stream and return it."""
+        slot = self.staged % self.SLOTS
+        done = self._copied[slot]
+        if done is not None:
+            done.synchronize()  # issued SLOTS rounds ago: complete in practice
+        self.host[slot] = length
+        self.device_len.copy_(self.host[slot : slot + 1], non_blocking=True)
+        if self.device.type == "cuda":
+            event = torch.cuda.Event()
+            event.record()
+            self._copied[slot] = event
+        self.staged += 1
+        return self.device_len

+"""Multi-GPU test of the one-kernel DCP reduce (dcp_push_combine): every rank
+holds [B, H, 128] partials of all heads with their LSE and gets back the LSE
+combine of its own H / N heads, as gathering every rank's partials and running
+the Triton combine does. Covers +0.0 payload words (the lamport marker), rows
+with no local key (+inf LSE), zero LSE, uneven batches, and repeated calls
+through both push-plane phases.
+
+Usage::
+
+    python test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_dcp_push_combine.py   # relaunches under torchrun (8 GPUs)
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import atexit
+import logging
+import os
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+import sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state as ps
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention import dcp_push_combine as pc
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dcp_kernels import dcp_lse_combine_triton
+from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce_v2 import (
+    CustomAllReduceV2,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import SpawnRanks, get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kernels.utils import multigpu_pytest_main
+from sglang.test.parallel_groups import publish
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=60, stage="extra-b", runner_config="8-gpu-h200")
+
+H = 96  # Kimi-K3.1 MLA heads, all held by every DCP rank
+MAX_ROWS = 1024
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _setup() -> ps.GroupCoordinator:
+    local_rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])
+    world_size = int(os.environ["WORLD_SIZE"])
+    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
+    dist.init_process_group(backend="gloo")
+    publish(
+        ServerArgs(model_path="dummy", tp_size=world_size),
+        role="test",
+        ranks=SpawnRanks(world_rank=local_rank),
+    )
+    coord = ps.init_world_group(
+        ranks=list(range(world_size)), local_rank=local_rank, backend="nccl"
+    )
+    ps._WORLD = coord
+    get_parallel().override_permanently(world_group=coord)
+    atexit.register(dist.destroy_process_group)
+    logging.disable(logging.INFO)
+    comm = CustomAllReduceV2(
+        coord.cpu_group,
+        torch.device(f"cuda:{local_rank}"),
+        max_pull_size=0,
+        max_push_size=MAX_ROWS * (H // world_size) * pc.SLOT_BYTES_PER_ROW,
+    )
+    assert not comm.disabled
+    pc.register_comm(comm.obj)
+    return coord
+
+
+def _reference(coord, v, lse):
+    n, rank = coord.world_size, coord.rank_in_group
+    hpr = v.shape[1] // n
+    all_v = [torch.empty_like(v) for _ in range(n)]
+    all_lse = [torch.empty_like(lse) for _ in range(n)]
+    dist.all_gather(all_v, v, group=coord.device_group)
+    dist.all_gather(all_lse, lse, group=coord.device_group)
+    recv_v = torch.stack([x[:, rank * hpr : (rank + 1) * hpr] for x in all_v])
+    recv_lse = torch.stack([x[:, rank * hpr : (rank + 1) * hpr] for x in all_lse])
+    out, _ = dcp_lse_combine_triton(recv_v.contiguous(), recv_lse.contiguous())
+    return out.reshape(v.shape[0], -1)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch", [1, 7, 64, 384, MAX_ROWS])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("calls", [3])
+def test_matches_gather_and_combine(batch, calls):
+    coord = _setup()
+    n, rank = coord.world_size, coord.rank_in_group
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(batch * 131 + rank)
+    for call in range(calls):  # odd and even push-plane phases
+        v = (
+            torch.randn(batch, H, pc.HEAD_DIM, device="cuda", generator=g) * (rank + 1)
+        ).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        v[:, :, :4] = 0  # +0.0 payload words must not read as "not arrived"
+        lse = torch.randn(batch, H, device="cuda", generator=g) * 4
+        lse[::5, rank] = float("inf")  # no local key
+        if call == 1:
+            lse[: min(batch, 3)] = 0.0
+        out = pc.dcp_push_combine(n, v, lse)
+        ref = _reference(coord, v, lse)
+        assert torch.isfinite(out).all()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref, rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2)
+
+
+def test_strided_inputs():
+    """Decode hands over the W_UV projection head-major and the LSE as a slice
+    of the padded-head buffer; neither is contiguous."""
+    coord = _setup()
+    n, rank = coord.world_size, coord.rank_in_group
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(11 + rank)
+    batch = 64
+    v = torch.randn(H, batch, pc.HEAD_DIM, device="cuda", generator=g)
+    v = v.to(torch.bfloat16).transpose(0, 1)
+    lse = (torch.randn(batch, H + 32, device="cuda", generator=g) * 4)[:, :H]
+    out = pc.dcp_push_combine(n, v, lse)
+    ref = _reference(coord, v.contiguous(), lse.contiguous())
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref, rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2)
+
+
+def test_cuda_graph_replay():
+    coord = _setup()
+    n, rank = coord.world_size, coord.rank_in_group
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(7 + rank)
+    v = torch.randn(64, H, pc.HEAD_DIM, device="cuda", generator=g).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    lse = torch.randn(64, H, device="cuda", generator=g)
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        pc.dcp_push_combine(n, v, lse)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        out = pc.dcp_push_combine(n, v, lse)
+    for _ in range(5):  # replays alternate the push-plane phase
+        v.copy_(torch.randn(v.shape, device="cuda", generator=g).to(torch.bfloat16))
+        graph.replay()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, _reference(coord, v, lse), rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    multigpu_pytest_main(__name__, __file__, num_gpus=[8])

+"""DFLASH draft KV ring: the rows the worker writes (DFlashDraftKVRing.locs, kept
+under the pool's DCP owner rule) are exactly the rows the window kernel reads in
+ring mode, the window floor holds, and an extend keeps only the tail a later
+window can read."""
+
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.mla_window_indices import mla_window_sparse_indices
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dflash_draft_ring import (
+    DFlashDraftKVRing,
+    draft_kv_ring_pool_rows,
+    draft_kv_ring_rows_per_req,
+    draft_kv_ring_unsupported_reason,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=20, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+WINDOW_LEFT = 1023
+BLOCK = 8
+
+
+def _ring(dcp, req_pool_rows, device, dcp_rank=0):
+    return DFlashDraftKVRing(
+        rows_per_req=draft_kv_ring_rows_per_req(
+            window_left=WINDOW_LEFT, block_size=BLOCK, dcp_size=dcp
+        ),
+        dcp_size=dcp,
+        req_pool_rows=req_pool_rows,
+        device=device,
+        window_left=WINDOW_LEFT,
+        dcp_rank=dcp_rank,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dcp", [1, 8])
+def test_window_reads_the_rows_the_ring_writes(dcp):
+    device = "cuda"
+    req_pool_rows = 9
+    ring = _ring(dcp, req_pool_rows, device)
+    pool_rows = draft_kv_ring_pool_rows(
+        req_pool_rows=req_pool_rows, rows_per_req=ring.rows_per_req, page_size=64
+    )
+    req_pool_indices = torch.tensor([3, 7, 1], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    prefix = torch.tensor([5000, 700, 3], dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    ring.min_pos[1] = 2  # request 2: a 2-token prefix hit
+    ring.min_pos[3] = 4100
+    positions = (prefix.unsqueeze(1) + torch.arange(BLOCK, device=device)).reshape(-1)
+    for rank in range(dcp):
+        indices, counts = mla_window_sparse_indices(
+            req_to_token=torch.empty((1, 1), dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
+            req_pool_indices=req_pool_indices,
+            positions=positions,
+            window_left=WINDOW_LEFT,
+            dcp_size=dcp,
+            dcp_rank=rank,
+            page_size=64,
+            ring_rows_per_req=ring.rows_per_req,
+            min_pos=ring.min_pos,
+        )
+        for row, p in enumerate(positions.tolist()):
+            req = int(req_pool_indices[row // BLOCK])
+            lo = max(p - WINDOW_LEFT, 0, int(ring.min_pos[req]))
+            keys = torch.arange(lo, p + 1, device=device)
+            locs = ring.locs(torch.full_like(keys, req), keys)
+            mine = locs % dcp == rank
+            expected = (locs[mine] // dcp).tolist()
+            got = indices[row, : int(counts[row])].tolist()
+            assert got == expected, (rank, row)
+            assert all(0 < r < pool_rows for r in got)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dcp", [1, 8])
+def test_window_and_block_never_share_a_row(dcp):
+    ring = _ring(dcp, 4, "cpu")
+    p = 123457
+    # The block's rows and every row a query in that block can read.
+    keys = torch.arange(p - WINDOW_LEFT, p + BLOCK)
+    locs = ring.locs(torch.full_like(keys, 2), keys)
+    assert locs.unique().numel() == keys.numel()
+    assert ring.span >= WINDOW_LEFT + 1 + BLOCK
+
+
+def test_extend_keeps_only_the_readable_tail():
+    ring = _ring(8, 4, "cpu")
+    lens = torch.tensor([3000, 40])
+    prefix = torch.tensor([0, 100])
+    positions = torch.cat(

+  exactly the tokens it owns (slot % N == rank) at row slot // N, byte-equal to
+  the DCP1 rows, leaving every other row untouched.

+def _write(pool, indexer, loc, batch, writer) -> None:

+                forward_batch=fb, layer_id=0, key=batch.index_key, out_cache_loc=loc
+            )
+        elif writer == "prepare":

+def _mla_rows(pool, rows) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return pool.kv_buffer[0].view(torch.uint8).view(-1, FP8_DS_MLA_BYTES)[rows]

+def _index_rows(pool, rows, buf=None) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """[len(rows), 132]: 128 fp8 bytes + 4 scale bytes of each index-K row."""
+    if buf is None:
+        buf = pool.get_index_k_with_scale_buffer(0)
+    buf = buf.view(-1, PAGE * (INDEX_DIM + 4))
+    page, off = rows // PAGE, rows % PAGE

+    scales = buf[:, PAGE * INDEX_DIM :].reshape(-1, PAGE, 4)[page, off]
+    return torch.cat([values, scales], dim=-1)

+# Index keys per request: ("random", n); ("tied", n, d): keys 2^j * B for

+    max_pages = -(-max(lens) // span)
+    used = [-(-n // span) for n in lens]
+    free = torch.randperm(TOPK_ROWS // PAGE - 1, generator=gen)[: sum(used)] + 1
+    table = torch.zeros(len(lens), max_pages, dtype=torch.int64)
+    for b, part in enumerate(free.split(used)):
+        table[b, : part.numel()] = part
+    pos = torch.arange(max_pages * span, device="cuda")
+    return (table.cuda()[:, pos // span] * span + pos % span).to(torch.int32)

+GRAPH_CHECKS, REPLAYS_PER_CHECK = 5, 20  # 3 * 100 calls per row slot > 255 tags
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _init_once() -> DcpTopKMerge:
+    local_rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])
+    world_size = int(os.environ["WORLD_SIZE"])
+    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
+    torch.cuda.set_stream(torch.cuda.Stream())
+    dist.init_process_group(backend="gloo")
+    ps._WORLD = ps.init_world_group(
+        ranks=list(range(world_size)), local_rank=local_rank, backend="nccl"
+    )
+    get_parallel().override_permanently(world_group=ps._WORLD)
+    atexit.register(dist.destroy_process_group)
+    logging.disable(logging.INFO)
+    return DcpTopKMerge(ps._WORLD, MAX_ROWS, TOPK)
+
+
+def _rows(kind: str, seed: int) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+    """The same global score rows on every rank."""
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    if kind == "random":
+        return [torch.randn(131072, generator=g)]
+    if kind == "dense_top":
+        # many distinct scores near the global threshold: overflows the v2
+        # merge's 10-bit threshold bin, not the local 12-bit ones
+        return [
+            10 + 0.3 * torch.randn(131072, generator=g),
+            10 + 0.3 * torch.randn(65536, generator=g),
+        ]
+    if kind == "ties":
+        return [
+            torch.randint(0, 200, (32768 - 100 * i,), generator=g).float() / 8
+            for i in range(4)
+        ]
+    if kind == "periodic":
+        # one rank owns the whole top-k: its candidates cannot certify it
+        rows = []
+        for n in (65536, 20000):
+            base = torch.randn(8, generator=g)
+            base[3] += 10
+            # distinct scores spread over many of v2's coarse bins, so the local
+            # top-k stays exact and the merge alone is under test
+            rows.append(
+                base.repeat(n // 8 + 1)[:n] + 4.0 * torch.randperm(n, generator=g) / n
+            )
+        return rows
+    if kind == "short":
+        lengths = [1, 3, 7, 9, 300, 2047, 2048, 2049, 2055, 3000, 5000]
+        return [torch.randn(n, generator=g) for n in lengths]
+    raise ValueError(kind)
+
+
+def _all_ranks_ok(ok: bool) -> bool:
+    """Agree on a check across ranks, so that a failure on one rank fails the
+    test everywhere instead of leaving the others waiting on its pushes."""
+    flag = torch.tensor([int(ok)])
+    dist.all_reduce(flag, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN)
+    return bool(flag.item())
+
+
+def _keys(scores: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    b = scores.float().contiguous().view(torch.int32).to(torch.int64) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+    ordered = torch.where(b >= 0x80000000, 0xFFFFFFFF - b, b + 0x80000000)
+    return ((ordered - 0x80000000) << 32) | (0xFFFFFFFF - pos.to(torch.int64))
+
+
+class _Case:
+    """One input set: this rank's shard of the rows and its expected results."""
+
+    def __init__(self, kind: str, seed: int, rank: int, world: int, span: int):
+        device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+        glob = _rows(kind, seed)
+        self.rows = len(glob)
+        lens = [x.numel() for x in glob]
+        self.local_lens = torch.tensor(
+            [max((n - rank + world - 1) // world, 0) for n in lens],
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        width = (max(int(self.local_lens.max()), 1) + 11) // 4 * 4
+        self.logits = torch.full((self.rows, width), float("-inf"), device=device)
+        for i, x in enumerate(glob):
+            local = x[rank::world]
+            self.logits[i, : local.numel()] = local.to(device)
+        self.global_lens = torch.tensor(lens, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        pages = (max(lens) + span - 1) // span
+        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed + 99)
+        self.page_table = (
+            torch.stack(
+                [
+                    torch.randperm(4 * pages, generator=g)[:pages]
+                    for _ in range(self.rows)
+                ]
+            )
+            .to(torch.int32)
+            .to(device)
+        )
+
+        self.expect, self.expect_local = [], []
+        for i, x in enumerate(glob):
+            local_pos = torch.arange(x.numel())[rank::world]
+            local_keys = _keys(x[rank::world], local_pos)
+            local_top = local_pos[
+                torch.topk(local_keys, min(TOPK, local_pos.numel())).indices
+            ]
+            self.expect_local.append(sorted(local_top.tolist()))
+            pos = torch.arange(x.numel())
+            top = pos[torch.topk(_keys(x, pos), min(TOPK, x.numel())).indices]
+            mine = top[top % world == rank]
+            pt = self.page_table[i].cpu().long()
+            slots = pt[mine // span] * span + mine % span
+            self.expect.append(sorted(slots.tolist()))
+
+        self.candidates = torch.empty(
+            (self.rows, TOPK, 2), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        self.out = torch.empty((self.rows, TOPK), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+
+    def run(self, merge: DcpTopKMerge, world: int, rank: int, span: int) -> None:
+        topk_transform_candidates_v2(
+            self.logits.clone(),
+            self.local_lens,
+            out_candidates=self.candidates,
+            world=world,
+            rank=rank,
+        )
+        merge(self.candidates, self.global_lens, self.page_table, self.out, span)
+
+    def failures(self, rank: int) -> list[str]:
+        bad = []
+        for i in range(self.rows):
+            got_local = self.candidates[i, :, 1]
+            if sorted(got_local[got_local >= 0].tolist()) != self.expect_local[i]:
+                bad.append(f"rank {rank} row {i}: local candidates are not exact")
+            n = len(self.expect[i])
+            if sorted(self.out[i, :n].tolist()) != self.expect[i]:
+                bad.append(f"rank {rank} row {i}: merged slots differ")
+            if not bool((self.out[i, n:] == -1).all()):
+                bad.append(f"rank {rank} row {i}: padding is not -1")
+        return bad
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["random", "dense_top", "ties", "periodic", "short"])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_dcp_topk_merge(kind: str) -> None:
+    merge = _init_once()
+    world, rank = ps._WORLD.world_size, ps._WORLD.rank_in_group
+    if world != 8:
+        pytest.skip("the merge needs 8 ranks")
+    if merge.buffer is None:
+        pytest.skip("multimem multicast unavailable")
+    span = PAGE_SIZE * world
+    cases = [_Case(kind, seed, rank, world, span) for seed in SEEDS]
+
+    for case in cases:
+        case.run(merge, world, rank, span)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        bad = case.failures(rank)
+        assert _all_ranks_ok(not bad), bad or "failed on another rank"
+        fell_back = merge.fallback[: case.rows].tolist()
+        if kind == "periodic":
+            assert all(fell_back), fell_back
+        elif kind in ("random", "short"):
+            assert not any(fell_back), fell_back
+
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        for case in cases:
+            case.run(merge, world, rank, span)
+    for _ in range(GRAPH_CHECKS):
+        for _ in range(REPLAYS_PER_CHECK):
+            graph.replay()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        bad = [msg for case in cases for msg in case.failures(rank)]
+        assert _all_ranks_ok(not bad), bad or "failed on another rank"
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    multigpu_pytest_main(__name__, __file__, num_gpus=(8,))

+from sglang.kernels.ops.kvcache.mla_buffer import set_mla_kv_buffer_cast_triton
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa.dsa_dcp import dcp_trtllm_sparse_attention

+register_cuda_ci(est_time=60, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+FP8 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+KV_LORA, ROPE, QK_NOPE, PAGE, TOPK = 512, 64, 128, 64, 2048
+DIM = KV_LORA + ROPE
+SM_SCALE = (QK_NOPE + ROPE) ** -0.5
+
+
+def _sm100() -> bool:

+class TestConcatCastQFp8Heads(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_matches_cast_and_keeps_pad_heads(self):
+        if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+            self.skipTest("needs CUDA")
+        gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+        for heads, target in ((12, 12), (48, 48), (96, 128)):
+            with self.subTest(heads=heads):
+                q = torch.randn(37, heads, DIM, generator=gen, device="cuda")
+                q = (q * 4).to(torch.bfloat16)
+                # strided views of one [T, H, 576] q, as the model passes them
+                q_nope, q_rope = q[..., :KV_LORA], q[..., KV_LORA:]
+                out = torch.zeros(37, target, DIM, dtype=FP8, device="cuda")
+                concat_and_cast_q_fp8_heads(out, q_nope, q_rope)
+                ref = q.to(FP8)
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    torch.equal(out[:, :heads].view(torch.uint8), ref.view(torch.uint8))
+                )
+                self.assertFalse(out[:, heads:].view(torch.uint8).any().item())

+class TestKvWriteCastOnStore(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_matches_cast_and_owner_rule(self):
+        if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+            self.skipTest("needs CUDA")
+        gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(2)
+        n, slots = 300, 4096
+        # strided nope / rope views of one latent row, as the model passes them
+        latent = (torch.randn(n, DIM, generator=gen, device="cuda") * 3).to(

+        slots, slots.stride(0), out, out.stride(0), lens, dcp, rank, TOPK=TOPK
+    )
+    return out, lens

+    def test_dcp8_partials_merge_to_full(self):

+            make_persistent_multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer,

+        dcp, heads, padded, rows, ctx = 8, 96, 128, 24, 16384
+        gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1)
+        kv = (torch.randn(ctx, DIM, generator=gen, device="cuda") * 0.5).to(FP8)
+        q = (torch.randn(rows, heads, DIM, generator=gen, device="cuda")).to(

+        # global top-k slots, valid first then -1; row 0 has keys on rank 0
+        # only, so the other ranks see an empty row
+        slots = torch.full((rows, TOPK), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+        counts = torch.randint(1, TOPK + 1, (rows,), generator=gen, device="cuda")
+        counts[1] = TOPK
+        for r in range(rows):
+            n = int(counts[r])
+            pick = torch.randperm(ctx, generator=gen, device="cuda")[:n]
+            if r == 0:

+            slots[r, :n] = pick.to(torch.int32)

+        workspace = torch.zeros(384 << 20, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+        counter = make_persistent_multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer(
+            torch.device("cuda"), padded, max_batch_size=rows
+        )
+        full, full_lse = self._attend(kv, q8, slots, counts, workspace, counter)
+        full = full.view(rows, padded, KV_LORA)[:, :heads].float()
+
+        outs, lses = [], []
+        for rank in range(dcp):
+            local_kv = kv[rank::dcp].contiguous()
+            table, lens = _localize(slots, dcp, rank)

+    """Replay how the sparse decode kernel and the combine consume a schedule

+    b = len(num_blocks)
+    assert splits[0] == 0 and all(splits[r + 1] > splits[r] for r in range(b))
+    assert splits[b] <= b + len(meta)
+    pieces = [[] for _ in range(b)]
+    max_cost = 0
+    for part in meta:
+        (
+            begin_req,
+            end_req,
+            begin_block,
+            end_block,
+            begin_split,
+            first_split,
+            last_split,
+        ) = part[:7]
+        if begin_req >= b:
+            continue
+        cost = 0
+        for r in range(begin_req, end_req + 1):
+            start = begin_block if r == begin_req else 0
+            end = end_block if r == end_req else num_blocks[r]
+            split_flag = (
+                first_split if r == begin_req else (last_split if r == end_req else 0)
+            )
+            split_idx = splits[r] + begin_split if r == begin_req else splits[r]
+            assert start < end <= num_blocks[r]

+        assert sorted(p[2] for p in pieces[r]) == list(range(splits[r], splits[r + 1]))

+"""mla_window_sparse_indices: per query row, the flat paged-cache rows of the
+window keys [p - window_left, p] that one DCP rank owns, against a Python
+reference of the cyclic DCP layout (position pos on rank pos % N at local slot
+req_to_token[pos] // N, page through v2p when given). The union over ranks
+must be exactly the window, each key once."""
+
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.mla_window_indices import (
+    mla_window_sparse_indices,
+    mla_window_top_k,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=20, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+PAGE = 64
+
+
+def _layout(seq_lens, dcp, with_v2p, seed):
+    """req_to_token of page-aligned requests in a shuffled pool, so slot % dcp
+    cycles with position, and a shuffled virtual->physical page table."""
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    cycle = PAGE * dcp
+    runs = [-(-s // cycle) for s in seq_lens]
+    order = torch.randperm(sum(runs) + 1, generator=g)[: len(seq_lens)] + 1
+    req_to_token = torch.full(
+        (len(seq_lens) + 3, max(seq_lens) + 16), -1, dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    pool_idx = torch.randperm(req_to_token.shape[0], generator=g)[: len(seq_lens)]
+    base = 0
+    for i, s in enumerate(seq_lens):
+        base = int(order[i]) * cycle * 64
+        req_to_token[pool_idx[i], :s] = torch.arange(base, base + s, dtype=torch.int32)
+    num_pages = int(req_to_token.max()) // dcp // PAGE + 1
+    v2p = torch.randperm(num_pages, generator=g).to(torch.int64) if with_v2p else None
+    return req_to_token, pool_idx, v2p
+
+
+def _reference(req_to_token, pool_idx, positions, q_len, window_left, dcp, rank, v2p):
+    rows = []
+    for r, p in enumerate(positions.tolist()):
+        req = int(pool_idx[r // q_len])
+        keys = []
+        for pos in range(max(0, p - window_left), p + 1):
+            if pos % dcp != rank:
+                continue
+            slot = int(req_to_token[req, pos]) // dcp
+            page = slot // PAGE
+            if v2p is not None:
+                page = int(v2p[page])
+            keys.append(page * PAGE + slot % PAGE)
+        rows.append(keys)
+    return rows
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dcp", [1, 8])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("window_left", [4095, 127])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("with_v2p", [False, True])
+def test_window_indices(dcp, window_left, with_v2p):
+    q_len = 8
+    ctx = [0, 5, window_left - 3, window_left, window_left + 1, 3 * window_left + 77]
+    seq_lens = [c + q_len for c in ctx]
+    req_to_token, pool_idx, v2p = _layout(
+        seq_lens, dcp, with_v2p, seed=dcp + window_left
+    )
+    positions = torch.tensor(
+        [c + i for c in ctx for i in range(q_len)], dtype=torch.int64
+    )
+    top_k = mla_window_top_k(window_left, dcp)
+    union = [[] for _ in positions]
+    for rank in range(dcp):
+        indices, counts = mla_window_sparse_indices(
+            req_to_token=req_to_token.cuda(),
+            req_pool_indices=pool_idx.cuda(),
+            positions=positions.cuda(),
+            window_left=window_left,
+            dcp_size=dcp,
+            dcp_rank=rank,
+            page_size=PAGE,
+            v2p=None if v2p is None else v2p.cuda(),
+        )
+        assert indices.shape == (positions.numel(), top_k)
+        ref = _reference(
+            req_to_token, pool_idx, positions, q_len, window_left, dcp, rank, v2p
+        )
+        indices, counts = indices.cpu(), counts.cpu()
+        for r, keys in enumerate(ref):
+            assert int(counts[r]) == len(keys), (rank, r)
+            assert indices[r, : len(keys)].tolist() == keys, (rank, r)
+            assert (indices[r, len(keys) :] == -1).all(), (rank, r)
+            union[r] += [(rank, k) for k in keys]
+    for r, p in enumerate(positions.tolist()):
+        assert len(union[r]) == min(p, window_left) + 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))

+    output = torch.randn(

+    )[:, :96]

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dim", [128, 512])
+def test_peer_exchange_bits_and_replay(dim):
+    fixture._init_world()
+    group = ps._WORLD
+    if group.world_size != 8:
+        pytest.skip("direct DCP exchange requires eight ranks")
+    rank = group.rank_in_group
+    exchange = DcpDirectAllToAll(group)
+    # The transport also runs on H200; its production tuning gate remains B300.
+    exchange.enabled = True
+    small, small_lse = inputs(1, rank, dim)
+    assert exchange(small, small_lse) is None
+    assert dim in exchange.buffers  # eager small-batch warmup reserves storage
+    output, lse = inputs(512, rank, dim)
+    for _ in range(2):
+        exchange(output, lse)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        partials, stats = exchange(output, lse)
+        combined, _ = dcp_lse_combine_triton(partials, stats)
+    for phase in range(4):
+        output.copy_(inputs(512, rank + 13 * phase, dim)[0])
+        lse[1, rank] = float("nan") if phase == 1 else -float("inf")
+        output.view(torch.int16)[0, rank, :4] = torch.tensor(
+            [0, -32768, 32640, 32705], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int16
+        )
+        all_o = [
+            torch.empty(output.shape, device="cuda", dtype=output.dtype)
+            for _ in range(8)
+        ]
+        all_lse = [
+            torch.empty(lse.shape, device="cuda", dtype=lse.dtype) for _ in range(8)
+        ]
+        dist.all_gather(all_o, output.contiguous(), group=group.device_group)
+        dist.all_gather(all_lse, lse.contiguous(), group=group.device_group)
+        reference_o = torch.stack(all_o)[:, :, rank * 12 : (rank + 1) * 12]
+        reference_lse = torch.stack(all_lse)[:, :, rank * 12 : (rank + 1) * 12]
+        expected, _ = dcp_lse_combine_triton(reference_o, reference_lse)
+        graph.replay()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        assert torch.equal(partials.view(torch.int16), reference_o.view(torch.int16))
+        assert torch.equal(stats.view(torch.int32), reference_lse.view(torch.int32))
+        torch.testing.assert_close(combined, expected, rtol=0, atol=0, equal_nan=True)

+    comm.init_fi_a2a_workspace(group)
+    direct = comm._FI_A2A_STATE["direct"]
+    dispatched = []
+
+    def recorded(output, lse):
+        result = direct(output, lse)
+        dispatched.append(result is not None)
+        return result
+
+    comm._FI_A2A_STATE["direct"] = recorded
+    try:
+        cases = [(batch, 0, 0) for batch in (1, 511, 512, 513, 768, 1024, 1025, 512)]
+        for batch, offset, padding in cases + [(512, 2, 0), (512, 0, 2)]:
+            output, lse = inputs(batch, group.rank_in_group, dim)
+            # Different pointer alignments must not split ranks between transports.
+            offset *= group.rank_in_group % 2
+            padding *= group.rank_in_group % 2
+            if offset or padding:
+                storage = output.new_empty(batch * 96 * (dim + padding) + offset)
+                output = (
+                    storage[offset:]
+                    .view(batch, 96, dim + padding)[..., :dim]
+                    .copy_(output)
+                )
+
+            def call():
+                return comm.dcp_a2a_lse_reduce(
+                    output, lse, group, comm_backend="fi_a2a"
+                )
+
+            for _ in range(2):
+                call()
+            graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+            with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+                result = call()
+            assert dispatched[-1] == (512 <= batch <= 1024)
+            for phase in range(3):
+                output.copy_(inputs(batch, group.rank_in_group + phase + 1, dim)[0])
+                graph.replay()
+                direct.enabled = False
+                expected = call()
+                direct.enabled = True
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    result, expected, rtol=0, atol=0, equal_nan=True
+                )
+    finally:

+                local_rows.append(physical)
+                offset += length

+            )
+            rows = torch.full(

+                None,

+            keys = (

+# Where test_collectives.py runs: the K3 fused collectives are SM100-only.
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=60, stage="base-c", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="nightly", runner_config="8-gpu-b200")

+N = 896 + 3584  # K3 [router | latent] rows
+H = 7168
+MB = 1024 * 1024
+TOKENS = [18, 96, 256]

+@cache_once
+def _init_world():
+    local_rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])

+    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)

+        local_rank=local_rank,

+    )

+    atexit.register(dist.destroy_process_group)
+    logging.disable(logging.INFO)
+    torch.cuda.set_stream(torch.cuda.Stream())
+    return coord.cpu_group
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _init_nccl_group():
+    _init_world()
+    local_rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])
+    group = dist.new_group(backend="nccl", device_id=torch.device(f"cuda:{local_rank}"))
+    assert isinstance(group, dist.ProcessGroup)
+    return group
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _build_comm() -> Optional[CustomAllReduceV2]:
+    cpu_group = _init_world()
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{int(os.environ['LOCAL_RANK'])}")
+    # 4 MB slots: the largest block here is TP2 at 256 tokens (2.3 MB)
+    comm = CustomAllReduceV2(
+        cpu_group, device, max_pull_size=1 * MB, max_push_size=4 * MB
+    )
+    if comm.disabled or not comm.has_multicast:
+        return None
+    all_reduce.register_comm(comm.obj)
+    register_comm_cleanup(comm)
+    return comm
+
+
+def _init_comm() -> CustomAllReduceV2:
+    if torch.cuda.get_device_capability() < (10, 0):
+        pytest.skip("the K3 MoE front gather is used on SM100+ only")
+    comm = _build_comm()
+    if comm is None:
+        pytest.skip("moe_front_ag requires CustomAllReduceV2 with multicast")
+    return comm
+
+
+def _device() -> torch.device:
+    return torch.device(f"cuda:{int(os.environ['LOCAL_RANK'])}")
+
+
+def _block(num_tokens: int, n_local: int, seed: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed * 1009 + dist.get_rank())
+    x = torch.randn(num_tokens, n_local, generator=g)
+    x[0, :4] = 0.0  # one +0.0 vector: the marker swap must not hang the spin
+    return x.to(_device())
+
+
+def _nccl_ref(block: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    world = dist.get_world_size()
+    parts = [torch.empty_like(block) for _ in range(world)]
+    dist.all_gather(parts, block, group=_init_nccl_group())
+    return torch.cat(parts, dim=1)
+
+
+def _assert_gathered(out: torch.Tensor, ref: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    # bit-exact up to the sign of zero
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref, atol=0, rtol=0)
+    zeros = ref == 0
+    assert torch.equal(out[~zeros].view(torch.int32), ref[~zeros].view(torch.int32))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_tokens", TOKENS)
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_moe_front_all_gather(num_tokens: int):
+    comm = _init_comm()
+    world = comm.world_size
+    n_local = N // world
+    # production gathers a column slice of the [block | gate_up] GEMM output
+    gate_up = 12288 // world
+    wide = torch.randn(num_tokens, n_local + gate_up, device=_device())
+    wide[:, :n_local] = _block(num_tokens, n_local, 300 + num_tokens)
+    block = wide[:, :n_local]
+    out = torch.empty(num_tokens, N, dtype=torch.float32, device=_device())
+    moe_front_ag.moe_front_all_gather(world, block, out)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    _assert_gathered(out, _nccl_ref(block.contiguous()))
+
+
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_moe_front_all_gather_stress_with_push_all_reduce():
+    # both use the one push workspace's phase double-buffering
+    comm = _init_comm()
+    world = comm.world_size
+    n_local = N // world
+    for it in range(24):
+        num_tokens = TOKENS[it % len(TOKENS)]
+        block = _block(num_tokens, n_local, 100 + it)
+        out = torch.empty(num_tokens, N, dtype=torch.float32, device=_device())
+        moe_front_ag.moe_front_all_gather(world, block, out)
+        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(it * 7 + dist.get_rank())
+        x = torch.randint(0, 16, (8 * H,), generator=g).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        x = x.to(_device())
+        ref_x = x.clone()
+        dist.all_reduce(ref_x, group=_init_nccl_group())
+        all_reduce.all_reduce_push_res(world, x, None)
+        _assert_gathered(out, _nccl_ref(block))
+        torch.testing.assert_close(x, ref_x, atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_moe_front_all_gather_graph_capture():
+    comm = _init_comm()
+    world = comm.world_size
+    cpu_group = _init_world()
+    n_local = N // world
+    num_tokens = 24
+    block = torch.zeros(num_tokens, n_local, dtype=torch.float32, device=_device())
+    out = torch.empty(num_tokens, N, dtype=torch.float32, device=_device())
+
+    def _run():
+        moe_front_ag.moe_front_all_gather(world, block, out)
+
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        _run()
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    dist.barrier(group=cpu_group)
+
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        _run()
+
+    for it in range(4):
+        block.copy_(_block(num_tokens, n_local, 500 + it))
+        ref = _nccl_ref(block)
+        dist.barrier(group=cpu_group)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        graph.replay()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        _assert_gathered(out, ref)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    multigpu_pytest_main(__name__, __file__, num_gpus=(2, 4, 8))

+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=10, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="Requires CUDA")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "cp_size,tokens,width",
+    [(8, 8192, 7168), (8, 17, 128), (2, 7, 33), (8, 1, 576), (8, 0, 128)],
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float32, torch.int64])
+def test_interleave_rows_roundtrip(cp_size, tokens, width, dtype):
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.memory.interleave_rows import interleave_rows
+
+    rows = (tokens + cp_size - 1) // cp_size
+    x = (
+        torch.arange(tokens * width, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int64)
+        .reshape(tokens, width)
+        .to(dtype)
+    )
+    expected = x.new_zeros((rows * cp_size, width))
+    expected[:tokens] = x
+    expected = expected.reshape(rows, cp_size, width).transpose(0, 1).reshape(-1, width)
+    rank_major = interleave_rows(x, cp_size, rows * cp_size, to_rank_major=True)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(rank_major, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        interleave_rows(rank_major, cp_size, tokens), x, rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
+    if tokens:
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            rank_major = interleave_rows(x, cp_size, rows * cp_size, to_rank_major=True)
+            restored = interleave_rows(rank_major, cp_size, tokens)
+        for v in [3, 11]:
+            x.fill_(v)
+            graph.replay()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(restored, x, rtol=0, atol=0)
+            # Check every pad row is overwritten with zero on every replay.
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                rank_major.reshape(cp_size, rows, width)
+                .transpose(0, 1)
+                .reshape(-1, width)[tokens:],
+                x.new_zeros((rows * cp_size - tokens, width)),
+                rtol=0,
+                atol=0,
+            )
+
+

+    """Row counts change with every batch, so a Triton kernel per token count would be loaded."""
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.memory.interleave_rows import _interleave_rows_kernel

+    constexpr = {

+        "input_rows": False,

+
+NUM_EXPERTS = 896
+TOPK = 16
+HIDDEN = 3584
+SCALE = 2.827
+
+
+def _routing_inputs(m: int, seed: int, shared: bool = False):
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    scores = torch.randn(m, NUM_EXPERTS, generator=g, device="cuda")
+    if shared:
+        scores = scores[:1].expand(m, -1) + 1e-3 * scores
+    bias = 0.1 * torch.randn(NUM_EXPERTS, generator=g, device="cuda")
+    x = torch.randn(m, HIDDEN, generator=g, device="cuda")
+    return scores, bias, x
+
+
+def _check_metadata(test, ids, meta, first, num_local, tile):
+    flat = ids.flatten().long()
+    local = flat - first
+    is_local = (flat >= 0) & (local >= 0) & (local < num_local)
+    counts = torch.bincount(local[is_local], minlength=num_local)
+    tiles = (counts + tile - 1) // tile
+    tile_offset = torch.cumsum(tiles, 0) - tiles
+    num_ctas = int(tiles.sum())
+    test.assertEqual(int(meta.num_non_exiting_ctas.item()), num_ctas)
+    test.assertEqual(int(meta.total_num_padded_tokens.item()), num_ctas * tile)
+
+    experts = torch.arange(num_local, device="cuda")
+    cta_expert = torch.repeat_interleave(experts, tiles)
+    cta = torch.arange(num_ctas, device="cuda")
+    mn_limit = torch.minimum(
+        (cta + 1) * tile, (tile_offset * tile + counts)[cta_expert]
+    )
+    test.assertTrue(
+        torch.equal(meta.cta_idx_xy_to_batch_idx[:num_ctas].long(), cta_expert)
+    )
+    test.assertTrue(
+        torch.equal(meta.cta_idx_xy_to_mn_limit[:num_ctas].long(), mn_limit)
+    )
+
+    per_expert = torch.zeros(NUM_EXPERTS, dtype=torch.long, device="cuda")
+    per_expert[first : first + num_local] = counts
+    test.assertTrue(torch.equal(meta.num_tokens_per_expert.long(), per_expert))
+
+    e2p = meta.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx.long()
+    test.assertTrue(bool((e2p[~is_local] == -1).all()))
+    p = e2p[is_local]
+    seg_start = (tile_offset * tile)[local[is_local]]
+    test.assertTrue(
+        bool(((p >= seg_start) & (p < seg_start + counts[local[is_local]])).all())
+    )
+    test.assertEqual(int(torch.unique(p).numel()), int(p.numel()))
+    p2t = meta.permuted_idx_to_token_idx.long()
+    token = torch.arange(flat.numel(), device="cuda")[is_local] // TOPK
+    test.assertTrue(torch.equal(p2t[p], token))
+    rows = torch.arange(num_ctas * tile, device="cuda")
+    padding = rows >= mn_limit.repeat_interleave(tile)
+    test.assertTrue(bool((p2t[: num_ctas * tile][padding] == -1).all()))
+
+
+class TestK31FusedRouting(CustomTestCase):

+
+    def _run(self, scores, bias, x, *, num_valid, first, num_local, tile, wdtype):

+            scores,

+            x,

+            tile_tokens=tile,
+            weights_dtype=wdtype,
+        )
+
+    def test_matches_route_quant_and_metadata(self):
+        cases = [
+            (1, 1, 0, NUM_EXPERTS, 8, False),
+            (6, 6, 0, 448, 8, False),
+            (12, 10, 224, 224, 32, False),
+            (12, 9, 0, 448, 8, True),
+            (16, 16, 448, 448, 8, True),
+            (24, 19, 0, 448, 16, False),
+            (96, 90, 0, 448, 64, False),
+            (256, 250, 0, NUM_EXPERTS, 192, False),
+            (64, 60, 448, 448, 256, False),
+        ]
+        for m, valid, first, num_local, tile, shared in cases:
+            with self.subTest(m=m, valid=valid, first=first, tile=tile, shared=shared):
+                scores, bias, x = _routing_inputs(m, seed=m + tile, shared=shared)
+                wdtype = torch.bfloat16 if m <= 64 else torch.float32

+                ref_i[valid:] = -1

+                self.assertTrue(

+                )
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    torch.equal(out.x_q.view(torch.uint8), ref_q.view(torch.uint8))
+                )
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(out.x_s, ref_s))
+                self.assertTrue(

+                )
