+def ledger(pieces):
+    tokenizer = SimpleNamespace(
+        model=SimpleNamespace(decode_single_token_bytes=pieces.__getitem__)
+    )
+    result = KimiTokenProvenance(tokenizer)
+    result.append(range(len(pieces)))
+    return result
+
+
+def ids(value):
+    return value[0]["token_ids"]
+
+
+def test_one_batch_thinking_and_answer_have_distinct_tokens():
+    source = ledger([b"same", THINK_CLOSE.encode(), RESPONSE_OPEN.encode(), b"same"])
+    assert ids(source.take("same", text=True, reasoning=True)) == [0]
+    assert ids(source.take("same", text=True)) == [3]
+
+
+def test_utf8_split_and_repeated_token_positions():
+    source = ledger([b"\xe4\xb8", b"\xad", b"!", b"!"])
+    assert ids(source.take("中", text=True)) == [0, 1]
+    assert ids(source.take("!!", text=True)) == [2, 3]
+
+
+def test_a_token_can_contribute_to_two_increments():
+    source = ledger([b"abcdef"])
+    assert ids(source.take("abc", text=True)) == [0]
+    assert ids(source.take("def", text=True)) == [0]
+
+
+def test_markers_in_argument_value_are_not_stripped():
+    source = ledger([RESPONSE_OPEN.encode()])
+    assert ids(source.take(RESPONSE_OPEN)) == [0]
+
+
+def test_channel_marker_words_do_not_steal_content_tokens():
+    source = ledger([RESPONSE_OPEN.encode(), b"response"])
+    assert ids(source.take("response", text=True)) == [1]
+
+
+def test_replayed_reasoning_uses_its_original_tokens():
+    source = ledger([b"first", b" second", b" tail"])
+    assert ids(source.take("first", text=True, reasoning=True)) == [0]
+    assert ids(source.take(" second", text=True, reasoning=True)) == [1]
+    assert ids(source.take("first second tail", text=True, replay_chars=12)) == [
+        0,
+        1,
+        2,
+    ]
+
+
+def test_text_spanning_removed_wrappers():
+    source = ledger([b"a", RESPONSE_OPEN.encode(), b"b"])
+    assert ids(source.take("ab", text=True)) == [0, 2]
+
+
+def test_mismatch_is_not_silently_assigned_arbitrary_ids():
+    source = ledger([b"actual"])
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="no matching"):
+        source.take("invented", text=True)
+
+
+def test_same_token_id_generated_twice_is_not_deduplicated():
+    source = ledger([b"a"])
+    source.append([0])
+    assert ids(source.take("aa", text=True)) == [0, 0]

+"""An FFN declaring output_on_cp_shards (Kimi-K3.1's latent MoE under CP-TP group
+sharing): on a CP extend whose input it takes gathered over attention CP, its
+output lands on this rank's CP rows, the residual's, so the exit keeps it as is
+instead of taking a block back. Every other path keeps its contract."""

+import unittest
+
+import test_declared_decoder_boundary as fixture

+from sglang.srt.layers.layer_boundary import TokenAxis

+from sglang.test.boundary_fixtures import build_stages

+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+CP = BatchVariant.CONTEXT_PARALLEL
+ORDINARY = BatchVariant.ORDINARY
+
+
+def _ffn(parallel, *, on_cp_shards=True, a2a=False):
+    with fixture.planning(parallel, dsa_cp=True, a2a=a2a):
+        _, ffn = build_stages(
+            (declare_attn(), fixture.Norm()),
+            (
+                declare_ffn(
+                    sparse=True,
+                    output_complete=True,
+                    output_on_cp_shards=on_cp_shards,
+                ),
+                fixture.Norm(),
+            ),
+            previous=declare_ffn(sparse=True),
+        )
+    return ffn
+
+
+def _sharing(**overrides):
+    fields = dict(
+        attn_dp=1,
+        attn_tp=1,
+        attn_cp=2,
+        enable_prefill_cp=True,
+        enable_cp_tp_group_sharing=True,
+    )
+    return fixture.parallel_of(**(fields | overrides))
+
+
+class TestFfnOutputOnCpShards(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_cp_extend_output_stays_on_the_residual_rows(self):
+        ffn = _ffn(_sharing())
+        edges = ffn.plan.edges[CP]
+        self.assertNotIn(TokenAxis.ATTN_CP, edges.incoming.need.layout.sharded)
+        self.assertEqual(edges.outgoing.produced.layout, edges.outgoing.residual_to)
+        self.assertIs(ffn.plan.paths[CP].output_move, keep_output)
+        self.assertTrue(ffn.plan.outputs_on_cp_shards(CP))
+
+    def test_without_the_declaration_the_exit_takes_the_block_back(self):
+        ffn = _ffn(_sharing(), on_cp_shards=False)
+        self.assertIs(ffn.plan.paths[CP].output_move, attn_cp_take_back_output)
+        self.assertFalse(ffn.plan.outputs_on_cp_shards(CP))
+
+    def test_an_ordinary_batch_keeps_its_contract(self):
+        declared, plain = _ffn(_sharing()), _ffn(_sharing(), on_cp_shards=False)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            declared.plan.edges[ORDINARY].outgoing.produced,
+            plain.plan.edges[ORDINARY].outgoing.produced,
+        )
+        self.assertIs(
+            declared.plan.paths[ORDINARY].output_move,
+            plain.plan.paths[ORDINARY].output_move,
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(declared.plan.outputs_on_cp_shards(ORDINARY))

+    def test_a_moe_on_its_own_rows_keeps_its_contract(self):

+    def test_requires_a_complete_sparse_output(self):

+            dict(sparse=False, output_complete=True),

+                declare_ffn(output_on_cp_shards=True, **kwargs)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""--pp-min-chunked-prefill-size uses the small PP prefill chunk unless a
+pending request, waiting or being chunked, has a full chunk of uncached tokens.
+Waiting requests are probed about once while they wait: later steps read their
+uncached hint."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler import Scheduler
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_MOD = "sglang.srt.managers.scheduler"
+
+
+def _req(input_len, matched, prefix_len=0, hint=None):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        seqlen=input_len,
+        num_matched_prefix_tokens=matched,
+        prefix_len=prefix_len,
+        pp_uncached_hint=hint,
+    )
+
+
+def _scheduler(
+    waiting, min_chunk=4096, chunked_req=None, policy_matched=True, overhead=None
+):
+    scheduler = Scheduler.__new__(Scheduler)
+    scheduler.pp_min_chunked_prefill_size = min_chunk
+    scheduler.pp_chunk_overhead_tokens = overhead
+    scheduler._pp_pending_tokens = 0
+    scheduler._pp_held_chunk = 0
+    scheduler._pp_dip_steps = 0
+    scheduler.page_size = 64
+    scheduler.chunked_req = chunked_req
+    scheduler.waiting_queue = waiting
+    scheduler.tree_cache = None
+    scheduler.policy = SimpleNamespace(
+        waiting_queue_prefix_matched=lambda q: policy_matched
+    )
+    return scheduler
+
+
+def _chunk(waiting, chunk=16384, pp_size=8, **kwargs):
+    scheduler = _scheduler(waiting, **kwargs)
+    parallel = SimpleNamespace(pp_size=pp_size)
+    with patch(f"{_MOD}.get_parallel", return_value=parallel):
+        return scheduler._pp_chunk_size_for_pending(chunk)
+
+
+class _FakeTree:
+    """Stands in for peek_uncached_tokens: answers from a per-request table of
+    cached tokens and counts the probes. It never touches the request's match
+    fields, as the real probe never changes cache or request state."""
+
+    def __init__(self, cached):
+        self.cached = cached
+        self.calls = 0
+
+    def peek(self, req, tree_cache):
+        self.calls += 1
+        cached = self.cached[id(req)]
+        if cached is None:
+            return None
+        return max(1, req.seqlen - cached)
+
+
+def _chunk_unmatched(waiting, tree, chunk=16384, **kwargs):
+    scheduler = _scheduler(waiting, policy_matched=False, **kwargs)
+    parallel = SimpleNamespace(pp_size=8)
+    with (
+        patch(f"{_MOD}.get_parallel", return_value=parallel),
+        patch(f"{_MOD}.peek_uncached_tokens", side_effect=tree.peek),
+    ):
+        return scheduler._pp_chunk_size_for_pending(chunk)
+
+
+class TestPPChunkByPending(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_high_hit_batch_uses_small_chunk(self):
+        # bs4 x 128K at 95% hit: 6554 uncached tokens each.
+        waiting = [_req(131072, 124518) for _ in range(4)]
+        self.assertEqual(_chunk(waiting), 4096)
+        self.assertEqual(_chunk(waiting, min_chunk=1024), 1024)
+        # Many short requests still use the small chunk, whatever their total.
+        waiting = [_req(32768, 26214) for _ in range(64)]
+        self.assertEqual(_chunk(waiting), 4096)
+
+    def test_large_prefill_keeps_full_chunk(self):
+        self.assertEqual(_chunk([_req(1040000, 0)]), 16384)
+        # Cold 32K requests have more uncached tokens than a chunk.
+        self.assertEqual(_chunk([_req(32768, 0) for _ in range(3)]), 16384)
+        # One cold request among high-hit ones keeps the full chunk too.
+        waiting = [_req(32768, 31130), _req(32768, 0), _req(32768, 31130)]
+        self.assertEqual(_chunk(waiting), 16384)
+
+    def test_long_chunked_req_keeps_full_chunk(self):
+        long_req = _req(262144, 0, prefix_len=262144 - 40000)
+        self.assertEqual(_chunk([], chunked_req=long_req), 16384)
+        tail = _req(262144, 0, prefix_len=262144 - 10000)
+        self.assertEqual(_chunk([], chunked_req=tail), 4096)
+
+    def test_new_requests_are_probed_once(self):
+        waiting = [_req(32768, 0) for _ in range(64)]
+        tree = _FakeTree({id(r): 31130 for r in waiting})
+        self.assertEqual(_chunk_unmatched(waiting, tree), 4096)
+        self.assertEqual(tree.calls, 64)
+        self.assertEqual(waiting[0].pp_uncached_hint, 1638)

+class TestPPChunkByLoad(CustomTestCase):
+    """--pp-chunk-overhead-tokens sizes the chunk from the total pending
+    uncached tokens U: 1500 tokens of overhead at pp4 moves from 4K to 8K at
+    U = 2 * 3 * 4096^2 / 1500 (67109) and from 8K to 16K at 268436."""
+
+    def _load(self, waiting, **kwargs):
+        return _chunk(waiting, pp_size=4, overhead=1500, **kwargs)
+
+    def test_chunk_follows_total_load(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._load([_req(8192, 0)]), 4096)
+        self.assertEqual(self._load([_req(67108, 0)]), 4096)
+        self.assertEqual(self._load([_req(67109, 0)]), 8192)
+        self.assertEqual(self._load([_req(131000, 0)]), 8192)
+        self.assertEqual(self._load([_req(131000, 0), _req(131000, 0)]), 8192)
+        self.assertEqual(self._load([_req(524000, 0)]), 16384)
+        # Many mostly cached requests add up: 32 x 13100 uncached tokens.
+        waiting = [_req(131000, 117900) for _ in range(32)]
+        self.assertEqual(self._load(waiting), 16384)
+        self.assertEqual(self._load(waiting[:8]), 8192)
+        self.assertEqual(self._load(waiting[:1]), 4096)
+
+    def test_chunked_req_keeps_its_size(self):
+        # Admitted with 131000 uncached tokens: 8K to the end of its prefill.
+        req = _req(131000, 0, prefix_len=131000 - 20000, hint=131000)
+        self.assertEqual(self._load([], chunked_req=req), 8192)
+        # Without a hint the rest is all that is known.
+        req = _req(1040000, 0, prefix_len=1040000 - 300000)
+        self.assertEqual(self._load([], chunked_req=req), 16384)
+        req.prefix_len = 1040000 - 20000
+        self.assertEqual(self._load([], chunked_req=req), 4096)
+        # Waiting requests add to the chunked request's load.
+        self.assertEqual(self._load([_req(65536, 0)], chunked_req=req), 8192)
+
+    def test_sum_stops_at_the_full_chunk(self):
+        waiting = [_req(524000, 0)] + [_req(32768, 0) for _ in range(8)]
+        tree = _FakeTree({id(r): 0 for r in waiting})
+        scheduler = _scheduler(waiting, policy_matched=False, overhead=1500)
+        with (
+            patch(f"{_MOD}.get_parallel", return_value=SimpleNamespace(pp_size=4)),
+            patch(f"{_MOD}.peek_uncached_tokens", side_effect=tree.peek),
+        ):
+            self.assertEqual(scheduler._pp_chunk_size_for_pending(16384), 16384)
+        self.assertEqual(tree.calls, 1)
+
+    def test_dip_keeps_the_larger_chunk(self):
+        # Two 131K requests at a time: between one prefill's end and the next
+        # request only one is pending, which alone would take 8K chunks
+        # (2000 tokens of overhead: 8K up to 201327 pending, 16K above).
+        scheduler = _scheduler([], overhead=2000)
+        two = [_req(131000, 0), _req(131000, 0)]
+        one = two[:1]
+
+        def size(waiting):
+            scheduler.waiting_queue = waiting
+            with patch(f"{_MOD}.get_parallel", return_value=SimpleNamespace(pp_size=4)):
+                return scheduler._pp_chunk_size_for_pending(16384)
+
+        self.assertEqual(size(two), 16384)
+        self.assertEqual([size(one) for _ in range(16)], [16384] * 16)
+        self.assertEqual(size(two), 16384)
+        # A lasting drop shrinks the chunk after 4 steps per stage.
+        self.assertEqual([size(one) for _ in range(17)], [16384] * 16 + [8192])
+        self.assertEqual(size(one), 8192)
+
+    def test_admission_adds_undercounted_tokens(self):
+        scheduler = _scheduler([], overhead=1500)
+        scheduler._pp_pending_tokens = 13100
+        # The hint said 13100 uncached tokens; the admission match found 131000.

+        with patch(f"{_MOD}.get_parallel", return_value=SimpleNamespace(pp_size=4)):
+            chunk = scheduler._pp_restore_full_chunk(req, adder, 4096, 16384)
+        self.assertEqual((chunk, adder.rem_chunk_tokens), (8192, 8192))
+        self.assertEqual(scheduler._pp_pending_tokens, 131000)

+import unittest

+from types import SimpleNamespace

+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.base_prefix_cache import (
+    InsertParams,
+    InsertResult,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.buffer_mode.pipeline import BufferModePipeline
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.buffer_mode.storage_existence_cache import (
+    StorageExistenceCache,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.cache_init_params import CacheInitParams
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import (
+    PoolName,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.radix_cache import RadixKey
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.components.base import ComponentType
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.components.full import FullComponent
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.unified_tree_core import UnifiedTreeCore

+    BufferBackupSnapshot,

+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def snapshot(node=7, hashes=None):
+    hashes = hashes or ["h1", "h2"]
+    return BufferBackupSnapshot(
+        node_id=node,
+        parent_node_id=0,
+        parent_is_root=True,
+        parent_last_hash=None,
+        hash_values=hashes,
+        key=RadixKey(array("q", range(2 * len(hashes)))),
+        prefix_keys=None,
+    )
+
+
+def pipeline(selective):
+    cache = MagicMock()
+    cache.page_size = 2
+    cache.enable_storage = True
+    cache.components = {}
+    cache.sidecar_pool_specs = []
+    cache.storage_existence_cache = StorageExistenceCache()
+    cache.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.get_kvcache.return_value = SimpleNamespace(
+        size=128
+    )
+    cache.tree_core.snapshot_buffer_backup.return_value = snapshot()
+    cache.tree_core.buffer_backup_pool_keys.return_value = {
+        ComponentType.MAMBA: {PoolName.MAMBA: ["h2"]}
+    }
+    cache.tree_core.collect_path_info.return_value = ((SimpleNamespace(path_end=4),),)
+    with envs.SGLANG_HICACHE_MAMBA_REQUEST_END_ONLY.override(selective):
+        result = BufferModePipeline(cache, swa_component=None, write_backlog_cap=128)
+    result._backup_oversize = lambda *args: False
+    return result, cache
+
+
+def real_tree_core(backend):

+

+    cache = SimpleNamespace(enable_session_radix_cache=False)
+    return UnifiedTreeCore(params, {ComponentType.FULL: FullComponent(cache, params)})
+
+
+def pump_insert(core, key):
+    step = core.begin_insert(
+        InsertParams(key=key, value=torch.arange(len(key), dtype=torch.int64))
+    )
+    while step.result is None:
+        step = core.resume_insert()
+    core.end_insert()
+    return step.result
+

+def insert(p, is_request_end, length=4, node=7):
+    p.begin_insert_walk(is_request_end=is_request_end, key_len=length)

+    p.end_insert_walk()

+                self.assertIsNone(p._insert_is_request_end)
+
+    def test_endpoint_retry_reads_hit_count_from_each_tree_core_backend(self):

+        # no Python node objects, so the hit count must come through the interface.
+        for backend in ("python", "rust"):
+            for threshold, expected in ((2, [7]), (3, [])):
+                with self.subTest(backend=backend, threshold=threshold):
+                    core = real_tree_core(backend)

+
+    def test_ancestor_is_not_promoted_to_request_end(self):

+    def test_request_provenance_including_prefill_completion(self):

+import unittest

+class TestMambaStaleCowSource(UnifiedRadixCacheHiCacheFixtures, CustomTestCase):
+    cfg = CacheConfig(components=(ComponentType.FULL, ComponentType.MAMBA))
+
+    def test_rematch_after_device_mamba_eviction_drops_cow_source(self):
+        # M = seq_a's internal node, with a device Mamba state.
+        cache, req_to_token_pool, seq_a = self._build_internal_mamba_fixture(
+            "write_back"
+        )
+        token_ids = array("q", seq_a)
+
+        # B is COW-matched against M (init_next_round_input), then the
+        # admission loop `continue`s: B keeps its slot and its COW source.
+        req = self._make_req(req_to_token_pool)
+        first = match_kv_cache(req, cache, token_ids, cow_mamba=True)
+        node_m = first.best_match_node
+        stale_src = int(req.kv.mamba_cow_src_index)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            stale_src, int(node_device_value(cache, node_m, ComponentType.MAMBA))
+        )
+
+        # M's device state is evicted; write_back demotes it to host.
+        cache.evict(EvictParams(num_tokens=0, mamba_num=10))
+        self.assertIsNone(node_device_value(cache, node_m, ComponentType.MAMBA))
+        self.assertIsNotNone(node_host_value(cache, node_m, ComponentType.MAMBA))
+        src_freed = stale_src in req_to_token_pool.mamba_allocator.free_slots
+
+        # Next admission pass matches B again.
+        second = match_kv_cache(req, cache, token_ids, cow_mamba=True)
+        src = req.kv.mamba_cow_src_index
+        if src is not None:
+            live = node_device_value(cache, second.best_match_node, ComponentType.MAMBA)
+            self.assertTrue(
+                live is not None and int(live) == int(src),
+                f"stale COW source slot {int(src)} survives the rematch: "
+                f"best_match_node device mamba={live}, "
+                f"slot back in free list={src_freed}",
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+class _Pool:

+    def prepare_locations(self, host_indices):

+        return [[0]] * len(locations), [[size]] * len(locations), [[0]] * len(locations)

+

+            linker.load_layer_wise(7, requests, [("a", 0.0), ("b", None)])
+        lines = [line for line in logs.output if "linker load" in line]

+        self.assertIn("rid=a pages=2 bytes=420 ", lines[0])

+pages are byte-identical: attention CP (interleave PCP) and attention TP
+(MLA-family pools, which have no head dimension to shard). A hybrid K3.1 group
+holds both kinds at once, so the choice is per pool: KV, indexer and an MLA
+draft are shared, while TP-sharded KDA state keeps its own rank namespace."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import PoolName
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.storage.mooncake_store.mooncake_direct_linker import (
+    _shared_pool_suffix,
+    _storage_sharing,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _k31_pools(dcp_sharded=False):
+    """A K3.1 hybrid group: replicated KV / indexer / MLA draft, sharded KDA."""
+    return {
+        name: SimpleNamespace(

+"""State-free PD decode radix tree (SGLANG_DECODE_STATE_FREE_RADIX): the tree
+keeps FULL KV only while each request keeps its own Mamba state slot. A
+finished request's prefix is still cached and matched in full, its state slot
+goes back to the pool instead of into the tree, and nothing ever asks the tree
+for a Mamba state (no copy-on-write, no eviction for state slots)."""

+import unittest
+from array import array
+from dataclasses import replace
+from types import MethodType, SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock

+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import FINISH_LENGTH, Req
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.allocation import ensure_mamba_capacity
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.common import release_kv_cache
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.components.base import ComponentType
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_radix_cache import UnifiedRadixCache
+from sglang.srt.sampling.sampling_params import SamplingParams
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci

+from sglang.test.kits.unified_radix_cache.fixtures import build_fixture, match_prefix
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase

+register_cuda_ci(est_time=20, stage="stage-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")

+# The fixture builds the hybrid pools through a no-buffer Mamba tree first,
+# which needs page 1; the FULL-only tree itself is page-agnostic.
+PAGE = 1
+
+
+def _state_free_cache():
+    """Pools of a hybrid-SSM model, tree of FULL KV only."""
+    cfg = CacheConfig(
+        components=(ComponentType.FULL, ComponentType.MAMBA),
+        page_size=PAGE,
+        mamba_cache_size=8,
+    )
+    hybrid, allocator, req_to_token_pool = build_fixture(cfg)
+    params = replace(
+        hybrid.cache_init_params,
+        tree_components=(ComponentType.FULL,),
+        request_mamba_only=True,
+        enable_mamba_extra_buffer=False,
+    )
+    return UnifiedRadixCache(params=params), allocator, req_to_token_pool
+
+
+def _request(req_to_token_pool, allocator, tokens, rid):
+    req = Req(
+        rid=rid,
+        origin_input_text="",
+        origin_input_ids=array("q", tokens),
+        sampling_params=SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_new_tokens=1),
+    )
+    req_to_token_pool.alloc([req])
+    req.output_ids = array("q")
+    kv = allocator.alloc(len(tokens))
+    req_to_token_pool.write((req.kv.req_pool_idx, slice(0, len(tokens))), kv)
+    req.kv.kv_committed_len = len(tokens)
+    req.kv.kv_allocated_len = len(tokens)
+    req.kv.cache_protected_len = 0
+    req.lock = None
+    req.extra_key = None
+    return req
+
+
+class TestDecodeStateFreeRadix(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_tree_holds_no_mamba_component(self):
+        cache, _, _ = _state_free_cache()
+        self.assertFalse(cache.is_mamba_enabled)
+        self.assertNotIn(ComponentType.MAMBA, cache.components)
+        # The cache still owns the requests' state slots.
+        self.assertTrue(cache.supports_mamba())
+        self.assertTrue(cache.supports_full_kv_only_match())
+        self.assertEqual(cache.mamba_evictable_size(), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(cache.mamba_protected_size(), 0)
+
+    def test_finished_request_is_cached_and_frees_its_slot(self):
+        cache, allocator, req_to_token_pool = _state_free_cache()
+        mamba_free = req_to_token_pool.mamba_allocator.available_size()
+        tokens = list(range(1, 13))
+        req = _request(req_to_token_pool, allocator, tokens, "finished")
+        self.assertEqual(
+            req_to_token_pool.mamba_allocator.available_size(), mamba_free - 1
+        )
+        req.finished_reason = FINISH_LENGTH(length=0)
+        release_kv_cache(req, cache, checkpoint=True)
+        cache.unlock(req.lock)
+        self.assertFalse(req.kv.holds_mamba)
+        self.assertEqual(req_to_token_pool.mamba_allocator.available_size(), mamba_free)
+        # Every page of the prompt is cached; no checkpoint caps the insert.
+        self.assertEqual(match_prefix(cache, tokens).device_prefix_len, len(tokens))

+    def test_request_released_before_kv_frees_its_slot(self):

+            origin_input_ids=array("q", [1, 2, 3]),
+            sampling_params=SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_new_tokens=1),
+        )

+        req.kv.mamba_pool_idx = req_to_token_pool.mamba_allocator.alloc(1)[0]

+        release_kv_cache(req, cache, checkpoint=False)
+        self.assertEqual(req_to_token_pool.mamba_allocator.available_size(), mamba_free)
+
+    def test_decode_admission_matches_full_prefix_without_state(self):
+        from sglang.srt.disaggregation.decode import DecodePreallocQueue
+
+        cache, allocator, req_to_token_pool = _state_free_cache()
+        shared = list(range(1, 9))
+        first = _request(req_to_token_pool, allocator, shared + [900, 901], "a")
+        first.finished_reason = FINISH_LENGTH(length=0)
+        release_kv_cache(first, cache, checkpoint=True)
+        cache.unlock(first.lock)
+
+        second = Req(
+            rid="b",
+            origin_input_text="",
+            origin_input_ids=array("q", shared + [700, 701, 702]),
+            sampling_params=SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_new_tokens=1),
+        )
+        req_to_token_pool.alloc([second])
+        queue = SimpleNamespace(
+            tree_cache=cache,
+            scheduler=SimpleNamespace(enable_decode_hicache=False),
+            _uses_swa_tail_prealloc=lambda: False,
+        )
+        queue._build_decode_prefix_match = MethodType(
+            DecodePreallocQueue._build_decode_prefix_match, queue
+        )
+        match = DecodePreallocQueue._match_prefix_and_lock(queue, second)
+        self.assertEqual(match.decode_prefix_len, len(shared))
+        cache.unlock(second.lock)
+        cache.sanity_check()
+
+    def test_state_shortfall_never_evicts_the_tree(self):
+        cache, _, req_to_token_pool = _state_free_cache()
+        allocator = req_to_token_pool.mamba_allocator
+        held = allocator.alloc(allocator.available_size())
+        req = Req(
+            rid="short",
+            origin_input_text="",
+            origin_input_ids=array("q", [1]),
+            sampling_params=SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_new_tokens=1),
+        )
+        with mock.patch.object(
+            cache, "evict_for_alloc", side_effect=AssertionError("evicted")
+        ):
+            self.assertFalse(ensure_mamba_capacity(req_to_token_pool, [req], cache))
+        allocator.free(held)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Breakable prefill CUDA graphs under decode context parallelism.
+
+Replay re-runs the break functions with their capture-time arguments, so the
+DCP extend gather must take the live batch from the forward context, and the
+runner must hand every replayed batch the bucket-sized gather buffer it
+captured. Prefix hits need the cross-rank all-gather and stay eager.
+
+    python -m pytest test/registered/unit/model_executor/test_prefill_cuda_graph_dcp.py -v
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.dcp.metadata import DecodeContextParallelMetadata
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_config import Backend
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import CaptureHiddenMode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.prefill_cuda_graph_runner import (
+    PrefillCudaGraphRunner,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.shape_key import ShapeKey
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_utils.forward_batch import set_forward_batch

+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+KV_LORA_RANK = 4
+ROPE_DIM = 2
+
+
+def _metadata(num_tokens):
+    return DecodeContextParallelMetadata(
+        dcp_kv_indptr=torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.int32),
+        dcp_kv_buffer=torch.zeros((num_tokens, 1, KV_LORA_RANK + ROPE_DIM)),
+        dcp_kv_indices=torch.arange(num_tokens, dtype=torch.int32),
+        dcp_local_prefix_kv_indices=torch.zeros(0, dtype=torch.int32),
+        dcp_extend_prefix_lens_sum=0,
+    )
+
+
+def _batch(num_tokens, prefix_lens):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        batch_size=len(prefix_lens),
+        input_ids=torch.zeros(num_tokens, dtype=torch.int64),
+        input_embeds=None,
+        replace_embeds=None,
+        forward_mode=SimpleNamespace(is_target_verify=lambda: False),
+        capture_hidden_mode=CaptureHiddenMode.NULL,
+        global_num_tokens_cpu=None,
+        return_logprob=False,
+        contains_mm_inputs=lambda: False,
+        extend_prefix_lens_cpu=prefix_lens,
+        extend_prefix_lens=torch.tensor(prefix_lens),
+        seq_lens=torch.tensor([num_tokens]),
+        extend_seq_lens=torch.tensor([num_tokens]),
+        req_pool_indices=torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64),
+        seq_lens_sum=num_tokens,
+        attn_dcp_metadata=None,
+    )
+
+
+def _runner(dcp_active):
+    runner = PrefillCudaGraphRunner.__new__(PrefillCudaGraphRunner)
+    runner._capture_req_slots = 4
+    runner.enable_lora = False
+    runner.capture_hidden_mode = CaptureHiddenMode.NULL
+    runner.max_num_tokens = 32
+    runner.capture_num_tokens = [8]
+    runner.max_context_size = None
+    runner.max_seq_len = None
+    runner.backend = SimpleNamespace()
+    runner.prefill_backend_name = Backend.BREAKABLE
+    runner.has_mha_companion_layers = False
+    runner._is_full_backend = False
+    runner._capture_chunked_prefix = False
+    runner.use_captured_attn_metadata = False
+    runner._dcp_extend_active = dcp_active
+    runner._dcp_kv_buffers = {}
+    return runner
+
+
+class TestDcpAdmission(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_prefix_hits_stay_eager_under_dcp(self):

+        self.assertFalse(runner.can_run_graph(prefix_hit))
+
+
+class TestDcpReplayMetadata(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_replay_reuses_the_captured_gather_buffer(self):
+        runner = _runner(dcp_active=True)
+        captured = torch.full((8, 1, KV_LORA_RANK + ROPE_DIM), 7.0)
+        runner._dcp_kv_buffers[ShapeKey(size=8)] = captured
+        planned = []
+
+        def plan(*args):
+            planned.append(args)
+            return _metadata(num_tokens=5)
+
+        attn_backend = SimpleNamespace(
+            req_to_token_pool=SimpleNamespace(req_to_token=torch.zeros((1, 8))),
+            token_to_kv_pool=SimpleNamespace(
+                get_kv_buffer_shape=lambda: (torch.Size([64, 1, 6]), None)
+            ),

+            resolve_prefill_shared_read_ends=lambda batch, **kwargs: None,
+        )
+        runner.model_runner = SimpleNamespace(
+            attn_backend=attn_backend,
+            model=SimpleNamespace(prepare_context_parallel_metadata_for_dcp=plan),
+            kv_cache_dtype=torch.float32,
+            device="cpu",
+        )
+        live = _batch(5, [0])
+        static = _batch(8, [0])
+        runner._prepare_forward_metadata_for_replay(live, static, ShapeKey(size=8))
+
+        self.assertEqual(len(planned), 1)
+        self.assertIs(static.attn_dcp_metadata, live.attn_dcp_metadata)
+        # Live indices, captured (bucket-sized) buffer.
+        self.assertIs(static.attn_dcp_metadata.dcp_kv_buffer, captured)
+        self.assertEqual(static.attn_dcp_metadata.dcp_kv_indices.numel(), 5)
+
+
+class TestDcpExtendGatherBreak(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_gather_writes_the_forward_context_batch(self):
+        from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_common.attention_forward_methods.forward_mla import (
+            bcg_dcp_extend_kv_gather,
+        )
+
+        capture_batch = _batch(8, [0])
+        capture_batch.attn_dcp_metadata = _metadata(8)
+        live_batch = _batch(8, [0])
+        live_batch.attn_dcp_metadata = _metadata(8)
+        k_nope = torch.ones((8, 1, KV_LORA_RANK))
+        k_pe = torch.full((8, 1, ROPE_DIM), 2.0)
+        with set_forward_batch(live_batch), prefill_graph_scope(full_graph=False):
+            # Replay re-supplies the capture-time batch as the argument.
+            bcg_dcp_extend_kv_gather(
+                None, None, capture_batch, KV_LORA_RANK, k_nope, k_pe
+            )
+        self.assertTrue(
+            torch.all(
+                live_batch.attn_dcp_metadata.dcp_kv_buffer[..., :KV_LORA_RANK] == 1.0
+            )
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(
+            torch.all(
+                live_batch.attn_dcp_metadata.dcp_kv_buffer[..., KV_LORA_RANK:] == 2.0
+            )
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(torch.all(capture_batch.attn_dcp_metadata.dcp_kv_buffer == 0.0))
+
+

+    unittest.main()

+"""--speculative-draft-window-size on the MLA-only DFLASH draft backends.
+
+trtllm_mla / cutedsl_mla read the draft's req_to_token rows by absolute
+position (sliding-window index lists, the DCP page table), so the compact
+draft table must be dropped where it changes nothing and rejected where it
+would. The expected verdicts come from a brute-force coverage check over
+request lengths, not from the resolver's own inequality.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import resolution_result
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.speculative_hook import _resolve_dflash_mla_draft_window
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dflash_utils import resolve_mla_draft_compact_window
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=12, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+HOOK_MODULE = "sglang.srt.arg_groups.speculative_hook"
+BLOCK = 8
+
+
+def _mla_draft(layer_types, sliding_window=None):
+    return {
+        "num_hidden_layers": len(layer_types),
+        "dflash_config": {"attention_mode": "mla"},
+        "layer_types": list(layer_types),
+        "sliding_window": sliding_window,
+    }
+
+
+def _compact_rows(prefix_len: int, window: int, page_size: int) -> range:
+    # The compact table's committed suffix (dflash_worker_v2
+    # _compute_compact_draft_seq_lens): the last min(prefix, window) positions,
+    # extended left to a page boundary, then the BLOCK draft positions.
+    visible = min(prefix_len, window)
+    start = prefix_len - visible
+    start -= start % page_size
+    return range(start, prefix_len + BLOCK)
+

+def _compact_changes_nothing(hf_window: int, window: int, page_size: int) -> bool:
+    """Brute force: for every committed length, each draft row's own window
+    [p - (hf_window - 1), p] lies inside the compact rows."""
+    window_left = hf_window - 1
+    for prefix_len in range(0, 3 * max(window, hf_window) + 2 * page_size):
+        rows = _compact_rows(prefix_len, window, page_size)
+        for p in range(prefix_len, prefix_len + BLOCK):
+            if max(p - window_left, 0) < rows.start:
+                return False
+    return True
+
